body.en: Jensen Huang publicly dismissed AI-extinction warnings as cheap headline-grabbing, pushing back on doomer narratives from the industry's most influential compute supplier.
body.zh: 黄仁勋公开驳斥AI毁灭人类论，称其为廉价的头条炒作，代表业内最具影响力的算力供应商对AI末日论的回应。

title.en: 黄仁勋开炮：“AI毁灭人类”纯属捏造，是博眼球的廉价炒作
title.zh: 黄仁勋开炮：“AI毁灭人类”纯属捏造，是博眼球的廉价炒作

body.en: Huang dismissed warnings of AI causing human extinction as fabricated, cheap clickbait and urged against efforts to stifle AI development.
body.zh: 黄仁勋称“AI毁灭人类”的说法纯属捏造、是博眼球的廉价炒作，并呼吁不要扼杀AI的发展。

title.en: Jensen Huang receives IJF Honorary Black Belt
title.zh: Jensen Huang receives IJF Honorary Black Belt

body.en: The International Judo Federation awarded Jensen Huang an honorary black belt.
body.zh: 国际柔道联合会授予黄仁勋荣誉黑带。

title.en: 黄仁勋：中国半导体的进步，归因于美国不断加码的监管
title.zh: 黄仁勋：中国半导体的进步，归因于美国不断加码的监管

body.en: Jensen Huang said China's semiconductor progress has been driven by escalating US export controls, weighing in on a policy debate central to Nvidia's China market access.
body.zh: 黄仁勋表示，中国半导体的进步是由美国不断加码的出口管制所推动的，就这一关乎英伟达在华市场准入的政策议题发表了看法。

title.en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang proposes making Kazakhstan global physical AI Hub
title.zh: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang proposes making Kazakhstan global physical AI Hub

body.en: Huang proposed building a 'global physical AI hub' in Kazakhstan, extending NVIDIA's push into sovereign AI infrastructure deals.
body.zh: 黄仁勋提议在哈萨克斯坦建设'全球物理AI中心'，延续了英伟达在主权AI基础设施合作上的布局。

title.en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang backed a Seattle lab with nearly 7 million GPU hours; its new AI model designs pr
title.zh: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang backed a Seattle lab with nearly 7 million GPU hours; its new AI model designs pr

body.en: NVIDIA backed a Seattle AI lab with nearly 7 million GPU hours, funding new AI-designed models as part of Huang's compute-allocation strategy.
body.zh: 英伟达向一家西雅图AI实验室提供近700万GPU小时的算力支持，助力其设计新AI模型，这是黄仁勋算力分配战略的一部分。

title.en: Jensen Huang Says AI Demand Is "Off the Charts." The Money to Pay for It Isn't
title.zh: Jensen Huang Says AI Demand Is "Off the Charts." The Money to Pay for It Isn't

body.en: Huang said AI demand is 'off the charts' while warning that the financing to pay for the buildout isn't there yet, weighing in on the industry's capex/financing debate.
body.zh: 黄仁勋称AI需求"爆表"，但警告支撑这轮基建投入的资金尚未到位，就行业资本支出与融资争论公开表态。

title.en: Jensen Huang Says AI Demand Is "Off the Charts." The Money to Pay for It Isn't
title.zh: Jensen Huang Says AI Demand Is "Off the Charts." The Money to Pay for It Isn't

body.en: Jensen Huang said AI compute demand is "off the charts" while warning that the financing to pay for the buildout has not caught up, surfacing the industry's capex-funding gap.
body.zh: 黄仁勋表示AI算力需求「爆表」，但同时警告支撑这轮建设的资金尚未跟上，揭示行业资本支出的资金缺口。

title.en: 黄仁勋出手！估值200亿，英伟达押注“华人机器人黑马”
title.zh: 黄仁勋出手！估值200亿，英伟达押注“华人机器人黑马”

body.en: Nvidia, under Jensen Huang, backed a Chinese humanoid-robotics startup at a $2 billion valuation, extending its robotics investment push into China.
body.zh: 黄仁勋领导下的英伟达以约200亿元估值投资一家中国人形机器人初创公司，将其机器人领域的投资布局延伸至中国市场。

title.en: 看上中亚煤都！黄仁勋首访哈萨克斯坦：要用10万块GPU把煤炭变智能
title.zh: 看上中亚煤都！黄仁勋首访哈萨克斯坦：要用10万块GPU把煤炭变智能

body.en: Jensen Huang made his first visit to Kazakhstan and outlined a plan to deploy 100,000 GPUs there, tying NVIDIA's expansion to the country's coal-rich energy base.
body.zh: 黄仁勋首次访问哈萨克斯坦，提出在当地部署10万块GPU的计划，将NVIDIA的扩张与该国丰富的煤炭能源基础相结合。

title.en: 黄仁勋痛斥AI毁灭人类言论：无稽之谈
title.zh: 黄仁勋痛斥AI毁灭人类言论：无稽之谈

body.en: Huang publicly dismissed warnings that AI will 'destroy humanity' as nonsense, pushing back on AI-doom rhetoric.
body.zh: 黄仁勋公开驳斥"AI将毁灭人类"的说法为无稽之谈，反击AI毁灭论的言论。

title.en: 【视频】黄仁勋对谈德国总理默茨！当面批德国、赞中国，还说了什么？
title.zh: 【视频】黄仁勋对谈德国总理默茨！当面批德国、赞中国，还说了什么？

body.en: At a Berlin 'Investing in Germany' summit, Jensen Huang told Chancellor Merz that Germany's manufacturing sector risks falling behind without embracing AI, while praising China as the only country combining deep manufacturing and computing strength.
body.zh: 黄仁勋在柏林"投资德国"峰会上对德国总理默茨表示，德国制造业若不拥抱AI恐将掉队，并称中国是唯一同时具备深厚制造业基础与强大计算能力的国家。

title.en: Jensen Huang Says Nvidia GPUs Could Last Over 8 Years, Not 4, Carry ‘Really High’ Residual Value: ‘Lowest Risk’ Assets for Lenders
title.zh: Jensen Huang Says Nvidia GPUs Could Last Over 8 Years, Not 4, Carry ‘Really High’ Residual Value: ‘Lowest Risk’ Assets for Lenders

body.en: Huang argued NVIDIA GPUs can last over 8 years rather than 4, giving them "really high" residual value as loan collateral — a direct rebuttal to depreciation concerns in the AI-infrastructure financing debate.
body.zh: 黄仁勋表示英伟达GPU的使用寿命可达8年以上而非4年，作为贷款抵押品具有"非常高"的残值——这是对AI基建融资中折旧担忧的直接回应。

title.en: 【视频】黄仁勋批评德国为什么是一种推销手段
title.zh: 【视频】黄仁勋批评德国为什么是一种推销手段

body.en: Huang criticized Germany's approach to AI regulation as effectively a sales pitch, arguing no country rivals China's manufacturing strength — a pointed public stance in the transatlantic AI-policy debate.
body.zh: 黄仁勋批评德国的AI监管做法实质上是一种"推销"，并表示没有哪个国家的制造业能比中国更强——这是他在跨大西洋AI政策争论中的鲜明表态。

title.en: 降价难！黄仁勋：内存过剩情况2029年都不会看到 反正英伟达疯狂用
title.zh: 降价难！黄仁勋：内存过剩情况2029年都不会看到 反正英伟达疯狂用

body.en: Huang said he doesn't expect a memory chip oversupply before 2029, since NVIDIA keeps consuming it aggressively.
body.zh: 黄仁勋表示，到2029年都不会出现内存芯片供应过剩，因为英伟达仍在疯狂消耗内存。

title.en: 华为与DeepSeek联手追赶 报告称黄仁勋“噩梦”成真
title.zh: 华为与DeepSeek联手追赶 报告称黄仁勋“噩梦”成真

body.en: A report says the scenario Huang feared is materializing as Huawei and DeepSeek team up to close the gap with NVIDIA.
body.zh: 报道称，华为与DeepSeek联手追赶，黄仁勋所担忧的局面正在成为现实。

title.en: Jensen Huang Fires Back in Berlin: Memory Oversupply by 2029 "Unlikely," Champions Long-Term HBM and LPDDR Demand
title.zh: Jensen Huang Fires Back in Berlin: Memory Oversupply by 2029 "Unlikely," Champions Long-Term HBM and LPDDR Demand

body.en: Speaking in Berlin, Huang dismissed fears of a memory oversupply by 2029, arguing HBM and LPDDR demand will stay strong for the long term.
body.zh: 黄仁勋在柏林表示，到2029年出现内存过剩的可能性不大，并认为HBM和LPDDR的长期需求将保持强劲。

title.en: 黄仁勋：没有哪个国家在制造业方面比中国更强
title.zh: 黄仁勋：没有哪个国家在制造业方面比中国更强

body.en: Huang said no country is stronger than China in manufacturing, a notable geopolitical comment on the AI hardware supply chain.
body.zh: 黄仁勋表示，没有哪个国家的制造业比中国更强，这是他在AI硬件供应链地缘政治问题上发表的引人注目的言论。

title.en: 黄仁勋回应与长鑫存储合作：持开放态度 没有哪个国家在制造业比中国更强
title.zh: 黄仁勋回应与长鑫存储合作：持开放态度 没有哪个国家在制造业比中国更强

body.en: Responding to questions about potential cooperation with Chinese memory maker CXMT, Jensen Huang said NVIDIA stays open to it and argued no country matches China's manufacturing strength — a notable public stance amid US-China chip tensions.
body.zh: 针对与长鑫存储（CXMT）合作的提问，黄仁勋表示持开放态度，并称没有哪个国家的制造业比中国更强——在中美芯片博弈背景下一次值得关注的公开表态。

title.en: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang Showcases AI-Powered Microducks That Sit, Stand And Nap On Command
title.zh: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang Showcases AI-Powered Microducks That Sit, Stand And Nap On Command

body.en: Huang showcased small AI-powered robotic ducks at a public event, part of NVIDIA's push into physical/embodied-AI demos.
body.zh: 黄仁勋在公开活动上展示了小型AI驱动机器鸭，是英伟达推进具身智能演示的一部分。

title.en: 黄仁勋回应是否考虑与长鑫存储合作：持开放态度 没有哪个国家在制造业比中国更强
title.zh: 黄仁勋回应是否考虑与长鑫存储合作：持开放态度 没有哪个国家在制造业比中国更强

body.en: Responding to questions about potential cooperation with Chinese memory maker CXMT amid a global memory-stock selloff, Huang said NVIDIA stays open to it and argued no country matches China's manufacturing strength.
body.zh: 在全球存储股遭抛售之际，针对与长鑫存储（CXMT）合作的提问，黄仁勋表示持开放态度，并称没有哪个国家的制造业比中国更强。

title.en: AI云崩了会救吗？黄仁勋：他们只是缺钱，不是没人用了
title.zh: AI云崩了会救吗？黄仁勋：他们只是缺钱，不是没人用了

body.en: Huang pushed back on fears of an AI infrastructure bubble, arguing the industry lacks capital, not users.
body.zh: 黄仁勋反驳AI基础设施泡沫论，认为行业缺的是资金，而不是用户。

title.en: 黄仁勋反击“AI毁灭人类论” 痛批为低劣炒作
title.zh: 黄仁勋反击“AI毁灭人类论” 痛批为低劣炒作

body.en: Huang dismissed warnings that AI will destroy humanity as low-quality hype, pushing back on AI-doom discourse.
body.zh: 黄仁勋驳斥"AI毁灭人类论"，称其为低劣的炒作。

title.en: Transcript of NVIDIA GTC Berlin 2026: Jensen Huang Full Keynote
title.zh: Transcript of NVIDIA GTC Berlin 2026: Jensen Huang Full Keynote

body.en: Full transcript of Huang's keynote at NVIDIA's GTC Berlin 2026 conference.
body.zh: 黄仁勋在英伟达GTC柏林2026大会主题演讲的完整文字记录。

title.en: Jensen Huang highlights strong demand for neoclouds despite financial constraints
title.zh: Jensen Huang highlights strong demand for neoclouds despite financial constraints

body.en: Huang says demand from neocloud providers is extremely high even as some face funding constraints.
body.zh: 黄仁勋表示新兴云服务商对算力的需求“高到离谱”，但部分厂商资金紧缺。

title.en: 黄仁勋：2029年内存难现供给过剩，与长鑫合作持开放态度
title.zh: 黄仁勋：2029年内存难现供给过剩，与长鑫合作持开放态度

body.en: Huang said a memory oversupply is unlikely by 2029 and signaled openness to working with Chinese memory maker CXMT (长鑫), a notable stance given US-China export-control tensions.
body.zh: 黄仁勋表示预计到2029年内存难现供给过剩，并对与长鑫存储（CXMT）合作持开放态度，在中美出口管制背景下这一表态颇为引人关注。

title.en: 从卖算力到管权限，英伟达GTC柏林，黄仁勋自己先喊了Agent刹车_公司新闻
title.zh: 从卖算力到管权限，英伟达GTC柏林，黄仁勋自己先喊了Agent刹车_公司新闻

body.en: At NVIDIA's GTC Berlin, Huang said the company is shifting focus from selling raw compute to managing agent permissions, and called for caution — a 'brake' — on autonomous AI agents.
body.zh: 黄仁勋在英伟达GTC柏林大会上表示，公司正从单纯出售算力转向管理智能体权限，并呼吁对自主AI智能体的发展保持谨慎，为其'踩刹车'。

title.en: 萌翻全场、笑声一片，黄仁勋带四只机器鸭上台演讲 当地时间10月21日，英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋在柏林举行的英伟达全球技术大会上，展示了使用RTX Spark芯片的机器鸭。演讲现场：黄仁勋展示开源小鸭子机器人Microduck，并和它进行互动演示。黄仁勋在台上俯身
title.zh: 萌翻全场、笑声一片，黄仁勋带四只机器鸭上台演讲 当地时间10月21日，英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋在柏林举行的英伟达全球技术大会上，展示了使用RTX Spark芯片的机器鸭。演讲现场：黄仁勋展示开源小鸭子机器人Microduck，并和它进行互动演示。黄仁勋在台上俯身

body.en: At NVIDIA's GTC Berlin keynote, Huang demoed four open-source 'Microduck' robots built on the RTX Spark chip.
body.zh: 黄仁勋在英伟达柏林GTC大会主题演讲中展示了四只基于RTX Spark芯片打造的开源机器鸭Microduck。

title.en: 黄仁勋：不担心DRAM过剩，愿与长鑫存储合作！
title.zh: 黄仁勋：不担心DRAM过剩，愿与长鑫存储合作！

body.en: Huang said he isn't worried about a DRAM glut and is open to cooperating with Chinese memory maker CXMT (长鑫存储).
body.zh: 黄仁勋表示并不担心DRAM过剩，并对与中国存储芯片厂商长鑫存储（CXMT）合作持开放态度。

title.en: 欧洲 AI 生态如何破局？黄仁勋呼吁本土建设更多新云算力
title.zh: 欧洲 AI 生态如何破局？黄仁勋呼吁本土建设更多新云算力

body.en: Huang urged Europe to build out more local cloud compute capacity to break its AI infrastructure deadlock.
body.zh: 黄仁勋呼吁欧洲加快建设本土云计算算力，以突破其在AI基础设施上的发展瓶颈。

title.en: 长鑫科技涨超7%，黄仁勋称对合作持开放态度
title.zh: 长鑫科技涨超7%，黄仁勋称对合作持开放态度

body.en: Huang said NVIDIA is open to cooperating with Chinese memory maker CXMT, calling China unmatched in manufacturing strength.
body.zh: 黄仁勋表示英伟达对与中国存储芯片厂商长鑫科技（CXMT）合作持开放态度，并称中国在制造业方面无人能及。

title.en: 黄仁勋：没有哪个国家在制造业方面比中国更强
title.zh: 黄仁勋：没有哪个国家在制造业方面比中国更强

body.en: Huang said no country rivals China in manufacturing capability, a stance that bears directly on the chip-export and supply-chain debate NVIDIA sits at the center of.
body.zh: 黄仁勋表示没有哪个国家在制造业方面比中国更强，这一表态直接关系到英伟达所处的芯片出口与供应链争议焦点。

title.en: 黄仁勋谈内存芯片供需：2029年前不太可能出现全面过剩
title.zh: 黄仁勋谈内存芯片供需：2029年前不太可能出现全面过剩

body.en: Huang said memory-chip supply is unlikely to see a broad glut before 2029, a forecast that bears directly on the HBM supply chain NVIDIA's AI accelerators depend on.
body.zh: 黄仁勋表示在2029年之前内存芯片行业不太可能出现全面产能过剩，这一预测直接关系到英伟达AI加速器所依赖的HBM供应链。

title.en: Jensen Huang pushes AI in energy-rich Kazakhstan, shrugs off bubble fears
title.zh: Jensen Huang pushes AI in energy-rich Kazakhstan, shrugs off bubble fears

body.en: Huang announced a roughly $10 billion push to build AI infrastructure in energy-rich Kazakhstan while dismissing concerns about an AI investment bubble.
body.zh: 黄仁勋宣布在能源丰富的哈萨克斯坦投资约100亿美元建设AI基础设施，同时对AI投资泡沫的担忧不以为然。

title.en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang dismisses memory oversupply fears in 2029, says ‘one of the things that is…’
title.zh: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang dismisses memory oversupply fears in 2029, says ‘one of the things that is…’

body.en: Huang dismissed fears of a memory-chip oversupply through 2029, a direct stance on AI compute supply economics.
body.zh: 黄仁勋驳斥了关于2029年前存储芯片供应过剩的担忧，直接表态了AI算力供应的经济学问题。

title.en: Jensen Huang says Nvidia's AI chips carry "the lowest" risk of any asset and could serve as collateral for debt
title.zh: Jensen Huang says Nvidia's AI chips carry "the lowest" risk of any asset and could serve as collateral for debt

body.en: Jensen Huang argued Nvidia's AI chips are the lowest-risk asset class and could even serve as loan collateral, a notable stance on how AI infrastructure financing should be viewed amid bubble concerns.
body.zh: 黄仁勋表示英伟达的AI芯片是风险最低的资产类别，甚至可以作为贷款抵押物，这是他在AI基建融资泡沫担忧声中给出的重要表态。

title.en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Says US Must Take China ‘Seriously,’ Warns Against Underestimating Its AI and Chipmaking Prowess: ‘If There's One Country That Could Manufacture Things at Scale’
title.zh: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Says US Must Take China ‘Seriously,’ Warns Against Underestimating Its AI and Chipmaking Prowess: ‘If There's One Country That Could Manufacture Things at Scale’

body.en: Huang said the US must take China's AI and chipmaking capability seriously, warning against underestimating its ability to manufacture at scale.
body.zh: 黄仁勋表示美国必须认真对待中国的AI与芯片制造实力，警告不要低估其大规模制造能力。

title.en: Jensen Huang pushes AI in energy-rich Kazakhstan, shrugs off bubble fears
title.zh: Jensen Huang pushes AI in energy-rich Kazakhstan, shrugs off bubble fears

body.en: On a trip to Kazakhstan to expand AI infrastructure, Huang dismissed fears that AI investment is a bubble.
body.zh: 在哈萨克斯坦推动AI基础设施建设之际，黄仁勋对AI投资存在泡沫的担忧不以为然。

title.en: Jensen Huang on Keeping AI Under Control: 'You Contain the Baby and You Monitor It'
title.zh: Jensen Huang on Keeping AI Under Control: 'You Contain the Baby and You Monitor It'

body.en: Huang laid out his approach to AI safety: contain the technology and monitor it continuously rather than halt its development.
body.zh: 黄仁勋阐述了他对AI安全的看法：对技术加以约束并持续监控，而非停止其发展。

title.en: 黄仁勋最新涉华发声
title.zh: 黄仁勋最新涉华发声

body.en: Huang forecast that memory-chip oversupply won't materialize before 2029 and described NVIDIA's "open" posture as AI-chip competition extends into storage coordination and supply-chain resilience.
body.zh: 黄仁勋预测内存芯片的过剩情况到2029年都不会出现，并表示英伟达对AI芯片竞争延伸至存储协同与供应链韧性领域持"开放"态度。

title.en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Wants Every Country To Build Its Own AI, Unveils Dsx Pod AI Factory
title.zh: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Wants Every Country To Build Its Own AI, Unveils Dsx Pod AI Factory

body.en: At NVIDIA's GTC Berlin keynote, Huang unveiled the DSX pod AI factory and called for every country to build its own sovereign AI infrastructure.
body.zh: 在NVIDIA GTC柏林主题演讲中，黄仁勋发布了DSX pod AI工厂，并呼吁各国建设自己的主权AI基础设施。

title.en: 英伟达黄仁勋：电信基站有望化身AI算力节点 演变为分布式AI网络
title.zh: 英伟达黄仁勋：电信基站有望化身AI算力节点 演变为分布式AI网络

body.en: Jensen Huang described telecom base stations evolving into AI-compute nodes within a distributed AI network, extending NVIDIA's AI-factory vision into telecom infrastructure.
body.zh: 黄仁勋提出电信基站有望转型为AI算力节点，演变成分布式AI网络，将NVIDIA的"AI工厂"愿景延伸到电信基础设施领域。

title.en: “世界科先声”编译：“没技术，谈啥监管？”黄仁勋点完德国，又提中国是“世界唯一”
title.zh: “世界科先声”编译：“没技术，谈啥监管？”黄仁勋点完德国，又提中国是“世界唯一”

body.en: Huang responds directly to investor concerns about CoreWeave's debt exposure and GPU depreciation schedules, and points to high gross margins on DeepSeek inference workloads to defend NVIDIA's core economics.
body.zh: 黄仁勋就投资者对CoreWeave债务和GPU折旧周期的担忧作出回应，并以DeepSeek推理业务的高毛利为例，为英伟达的核心盈利模型辩护。

body.en: Huang quantifies the cost of infrastructure delay, estimating that a three-month slip in bringing an AI data center online costs roughly $10 billion in lost revenue, underscoring the urgency behind NVIDIA's supply push.
body.zh: 黄仁勋给出具体测算：AI数据中心投产延迟三个月，将造成约100亿美元的收入损失，凸显英伟达加速供应节奏背后的紧迫性。

body.zh: 黄仁勋与宇树科技王兴兴均表示，物理AI与机器人正迎来爆发性拐点，成为英伟达计算栈的重要落地场景。

title.zh: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang says neocloud demand is 'off the charts' but capital is scarce

body.en: Speaking alongside the German chancellor at GTC Berlin, Huang highlighted China's manufacturing and compute advantages as NVIDIA announced a roughly $10B investment in Germany.
body.zh: 黄仁勋在GTC柏林大会上与德国总理同台，指出中国在制造业和计算产业方面的优势，同时英伟达宣布向德国投资约100亿美元。

title.en: 德国总理默茨争取AI主权，黄仁勋把话挑明：欧洲有产业吗，就想着监管
title.zh: 德国总理默茨争取AI主权，黄仁勋把话挑明：欧洲有产业吗，就想着监管

body.en: Jensen Huang pushed back on Europe's AI-sovereignty push, telling Germany's chancellor Europe lacks an industry and is focused on regulation instead.
body.zh: 黄仁勋对欧洲争取AI主权的举动提出反驳，直言欧洲没有产业基础，却只想着监管。

title.en: 英伟达黄仁勋劝诫欧洲各国：别再对AI过度犹疑，否则将被时代甩在身后
title.zh: 英伟达黄仁勋劝诫欧洲各国：别再对AI过度犹疑，否则将被时代甩在身后

body.en: Huang urged European governments not to be overly cautious on AI, warning they risk being left behind if they hesitate.
body.zh: 黄仁勋劝诫欧洲各国不要对AI过度犹疑，警告若继续迟疑将被时代甩在身后。

title.en: 黄仁勋当德国总理面盛赞中国 称赞制造业与计算机科学结合
title.zh: 黄仁勋当德国总理面盛赞中国 称赞制造业与计算机科学结合

body.en: At GTC Berlin, Jensen Huang praised China's combination of manufacturing scale and computer-science talent in front of the German Chancellor, a notable public stance on the geopolitics of the chip race.
body.zh: 在GTC柏林期间，黄仁勋在德国总理面前称赞中国制造业规模与计算机科学人才的结合，这是他在芯片竞赛地缘政治背景下的一次值得关注的公开表态。

title.en: GTC Berlin 2026: Live Updates From NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang’s Keynote
title.zh: GTC Berlin 2026: Live Updates From NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang’s Keynote

body.en: NVIDIA's own blog live-covered Jensen Huang's GTC Berlin 2026 keynote, the company's flagship venue for new product and platform announcements.
body.zh: 英伟达官方博客对黄仁勋在GTC柏林2026的主题演讲进行了现场直播报道，这是公司发布新产品与平台的旗舰场合。

title.en: Jensen Huang: In the future, telecom base stations are expected to evolve into distributed AI networks, with all telecom operators providing AI computing power.
title.zh: Jensen Huang: In the future, telecom base stations are expected to evolve into distributed AI networks, with all telecom operators providing AI computing power.

body.en: Huang predicted telecom base stations will evolve into distributed AI networks with operators selling AI compute, a forward-looking remark from his Germany trip.
body.zh: 黄仁勋预测电信基站将演变为分布式AI网络，运营商将出售AI算力，这是他德国之行中的一句前瞻性表态。

title.en: 黄仁勋：英伟达已向欧洲科技生态投入近100亿美元
title.zh: 黄仁勋：英伟达已向欧洲科技生态投入近100亿美元

body.en: Huang said NVIDIA has invested nearly $10 billion in Europe's tech ecosystem, underscoring the company's deepening commitment to the region.
body.zh: 黄仁勋表示英伟达已向欧洲科技生态投入近100亿美元，凸显公司对该地区承诺的不断加深。

title.en: 黄仁勋“教育”英德：发展AI别想太多 ，“你们光动口不动手”
title.zh: 黄仁勋“教育”英德：发展AI别想太多 ，“你们光动口不动手”

body.en: Huang pointedly told the UK and Germany to act rather than just talk on AI, a sharp public critique of the pace of European AI policy.
body.zh: 黄仁勋直言英国和德国在AI上"光动口不动手"，尖锐批评欧洲在AI政策推进上的迟缓。

title.en: Jensen Huang Nvidia GTC keynote disrupted by Greenpeace protest over chips in Russian drones — 'What are you doing about that?' heckler demands before being thrown out
title.zh: Jensen Huang Nvidia GTC keynote disrupted by Greenpeace protest over chips in Russian drones — 'What are you doing about that?' heckler demands before being thrown out

body.en: A Greenpeace protester disrupted Huang's GTC Berlin keynote over NVIDIA chips allegedly found in Russian drones, forcing him to respond on stage.
body.zh: 绿色和平抗议者在黄仁勋柏林GTC主题演讲上闯入抗议，指责英伟达芯片出现在俄罗斯无人机中，迫使他当场回应。

title.en: For years people wondered how Jensen Huang gave back to Stanford — until a $30 million gift revealed his vision
title.zh: For years people wondered how Jensen Huang gave back to Stanford — until a $30 million gift revealed his vision

body.en: Huang's $30 million gift to Stanford was revealed, underscoring his continued philanthropic ties to the university.
body.zh: 黄仁勋向斯坦福大学捐赠3000万美元的消息被披露，显示他与该校持续的慈善联系。

title.en: Jensen Huang Speaks at GTC Berlin: Telecom Base Stations to Become Distributed AI Networks, 1GW Data Center to Cost About NT$1.6 Trillion
title.zh: Jensen Huang Speaks at GTC Berlin: Telecom Base Stations to Become Distributed AI Networks, 1GW Data Center to Cost About NT$1.6 Trillion

body.en: At GTC Berlin, Huang said telecom base stations will evolve into distributed AI networks, with operators selling AI compute, a stance on telecom's future role in AI infrastructure.
body.zh: 黄仁勋在柏林GTC大会上表示，电信基站将演变为分布式AI网络，运营商将提供AI算力，这是他对电信业在AI基础设施中未来角色的判断。

title.en: Nvidia’s Jensen Huang Unveils Container-Sized AI Factories At GTC Berlin, Puts 1-Gigawatt Cost At $50 Billion
title.zh: Nvidia’s Jensen Huang Unveils Container-Sized AI Factories At GTC Berlin, Puts 1-Gigawatt Cost At $50 Billion

body.en: Huang unveiled container-sized AI factory units at GTC Berlin, pricing a 1-gigawatt deployment at roughly $50 billion.
body.zh: 黄仁勋在GTC柏林大会上发布了集装箱式AI工厂产品，并将1吉瓦部署的成本定为约500亿美元。

title.en: 黄仁勋：保时捷、欧莱雅、沃达丰等欧洲巨头均采用英伟达AI技术
title.zh: 黄仁勋：保时捷、欧莱雅、沃达丰等欧洲巨头均采用英伟达AI技术

body.en: Huang said major European firms including Porsche, L'Oreal and Vodafone have adopted NVIDIA's AI technology.
body.zh: 黄仁勋表示保时捷、欧莱雅、沃达丰等欧洲企业已采用英伟达的AI技术。

title.en: Nvidia GTC Berlin Keynote: Jensen Huang Puts $50 Billion Price Tag On 1GW AI Factory Amid DSX POD Launch
title.zh: Nvidia GTC Berlin Keynote: Jensen Huang Puts $50 Billion Price Tag On 1GW AI Factory Amid DSX POD Launch

body.en: At NVIDIA's GTC Berlin keynote, Huang put a $50 billion price tag on a 1-gigawatt AI factory and launched the DSX POD data-center design.
body.zh: 在NVIDIA GTC柏林主题演讲中，黄仁勋为1吉瓦规模的AI工厂给出了500亿美元的造价，并发布了DSX POD数据中心设计。

title.en: Jensen Huang At GTC Berlin: Nvidia Showcases A Full Stack
title.zh: Jensen Huang At GTC Berlin: Nvidia Showcases A Full Stack

body.en: Huang showcased Nvidia's full AI stack at GTC Berlin, underscoring the company's end-to-end platform strategy.
body.zh: 黄仁勋在柏林GTC大会上展示了英伟达的全栈AI方案，凸显公司端到端平台战略。

title.en: 'Nvidia, clean your dirty business!': Greenpeace protesters interrupt Jensen Huang’s Berlin keynote over Ru...
title.zh: 'Nvidia, clean your dirty business!': Greenpeace protesters interrupt Jensen Huang’s Berlin keynote over Ru...

body.en: Greenpeace protesters interrupted Huang's GTC Berlin keynote over Nvidia's business ties to Russia.
body.zh: 绿色和平抗议者在黄仁勋柏林GTC主题演讲上进行抗议，指责英伟达与俄罗斯的商业往来。

title.en: Jensen Huang’s Vision for Europe Runs on Plug-In Data Centers
title.zh: Jensen Huang’s Vision for Europe Runs on Plug-In Data Centers

body.en: At NVIDIA's GTC Berlin keynote, Jensen Huang unveiled DSX POD, a prefabricated, plug-in data center that can be deployed in as little as 14 days, part of his push into Europe's AI infrastructure build-out.
body.zh: 在NVIDIA GTC柏林大会的主题演讲中，黄仁勋发布了DSX POD预制式“插电”数据中心，最快14天即可部署，是其布局欧洲AI基础设施的重要一步。

title.en: Nvidia's Jensen Huang Says Paying $8 Billion Under California's Prop 40 Would Be a 'Privilege'
title.zh: Nvidia's Jensen Huang Says Paying $8 Billion Under California's Prop 40 Would Be a 'Privilege'

body.en: Jensen Huang said paying an estimated $8 billion under California's Proposition 40 would be a 'privilege,' a notable public remark on the state tax measure.
body.zh: 黄仁勋表示，若需按加州40号提案缴纳约80亿美元税款，他认为这是一种“荣幸”，这是他对该州税收提案的一次公开表态。

title.en: Jensen Huang on RTK Spark: One petaflop of AI power 'you can hold in your hands'
title.zh: Jensen Huang on RTK Spark: One petaflop of AI power 'you can hold in your hands'

body.en: Huang showcased NVIDIA's RTX Spark desktop AI system, calling it "one petaflop of AI power you can hold in your hands."
body.zh: 黄仁勋展示了英伟达RTX Spark桌面AI设备，称其为“可以拿在手中的一拍flops算力”。

title.en: 新架构Vera Rubin、RTX Spark电脑、机器人研发进展、自动驾驶车队畅想⋯⋯黄仁勋“2026 GTC”演讲重点速览！
title.zh: 新架构Vera Rubin、RTX Spark电脑、机器人研发进展、自动驾驶车队畅想⋯⋯黄仁勋“2026 GTC”演讲重点速览！

body.en: At GTC 2026, Huang unveiled the Vera Rubin architecture and the RTX Spark desktop computer, and showed new progress in robotics and autonomous driving.
body.zh: 在2026 GTC大会上，黄仁勋发布了Vera Rubin新架构和RTX Spark桌面电脑，并展示了机器人与自动驾驶方面的新进展。

title.en: 黄仁勋2026柏林GTC：欧洲应成为AI生产者而非使用者 英伟达首席执行官*「想要融入AI经济，不能只做AI的使用者，更要成为AI的生产者。」*在2026柏林GTC发表主旨演讲时表示
title.zh: 黄仁勋2026柏林GTC：欧洲应成为AI生产者而非使用者 英伟达首席执行官*「想要融入AI经济，不能只做AI的使用者，更要成为AI的生产者。」*在2026柏林GTC发表主旨演讲时表示

body.en: At GTC Berlin, Huang argued Europe must become an AI producer rather than just a user to fully participate in the AI economy.
body.zh: 黄仁勋在柏林GTC表示，欧洲应成为AI的生产者而非单纯使用者，才能真正融入AI经济。

title.en: 黄仁勋GTC柏林演讲：AI工厂部署最快缩至14天 智能体与物理AI加速落地
title.zh: 黄仁勋GTC柏林演讲：AI工厂部署最快缩至14天 智能体与物理AI加速落地

body.en: At NVIDIA's GTC Berlin keynote, Huang said AI factory deployment times have shrunk to as little as 14 days, as agentic and physical AI move toward real-world rollout.
body.zh: 黄仁勋在英伟达GTC柏林主题演讲中表示，AI工厂的部署周期已最快缩短至14天，智能体与物理AI正加速落地。

title.en: Jensen Huang’s GTC Keynote Turned Chaos: Protesters Demand Answers on Nvidia Chips in Russian Missiles
title.zh: Jensen Huang’s GTC Keynote Turned Chaos: Protesters Demand Answers on Nvidia Chips in Russian Missiles

body.en: Huang's GTC keynote was disrupted by protesters demanding accountability over Nvidia chips found in Russian missiles.
body.zh: 黄仁勋在GTC的主题演讲遭到抗议者打断，抗议者要求对在俄罗斯导弹中发现的英伟达芯片追责。

title.en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang says data center builders have to be 'good neighbors'
title.zh: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang says data center builders have to be 'good neighbors'

body.en: At GTC Berlin, Huang said companies building AI data centers need to be "good neighbors" to the communities around them.
body.zh: 黄仁勋在柏林GTC大会上表示，建设AI数据中心的公司需要做周边社区的"好邻居"。

title.en: 英伟达柏林GTC大会召开 市场聚焦黄仁勋为何加码欧洲
title.zh: 英伟达柏林GTC大会召开 市场聚焦黄仁勋为何加码欧洲

body.en: At NVIDIA's GTC Berlin keynote, Huang made the case for deepening NVIDIA's investment in Europe, part of a roughly $10B European AI buildout.
body.zh: 在英伟达柏林GTC大会的主题演讲中，黄仁勋阐述了公司为何加大对欧洲的投资，这是英伟达约100亿美元欧洲AI布局的一部分。

title.en: NVIDIA’s Jensen Huang Says GPUs Now Last 8 Years Or More, While Elon Musk Says Even Older GPUs Deliver A Higher “Intelligence Per Watt”
title.zh: NVIDIA’s Jensen Huang Says GPUs Now Last 8 Years Or More, While Elon Musk Says Even Older GPUs Deliver A Higher “Intelligence Per Watt”

body.en: Huang pushed back on the 'GPUs depreciate fast' narrative, saying NVIDIA GPUs now last 8 years or more — a direct answer to bear-case arguments about AI capex.
body.zh: 黄仁勋反驳了“GPU很快贬值”的说法，称英伟达的GPU现在可以使用8年甚至更久，直接回应了对AI资本支出看空的论调。

title.en: 黄仁勋：英伟达已能批量造超级计算机，同时为数百个数据中心供货
title.zh: 黄仁勋：英伟达已能批量造超级计算机，同时为数百个数据中心供货

body.en: Huang says NVIDIA can now mass-produce supercomputers and is supplying hundreds of data centers simultaneously.
body.zh: 黄仁勋表示英伟达现在已能批量生产超级计算机，并同时为数百个数据中心供货。

title.en: 黄仁勋说人工智能其实是制造业
title.zh: 黄仁勋说人工智能其实是制造业

body.en: Huang said publicly that AI is, in essence, a manufacturing industry — his latest framing of NVIDIA's role in the AI buildout.
body.zh: 黄仁勋公开表示，人工智能本质上是一种制造业——这是他对英伟达在人工智能建设中角色的最新表述。

title.en: Nvidia's Jensen Huang wants to build AI factories in weeks, not months
title.zh: Nvidia's Jensen Huang wants to build AI factories in weeks, not months

body.en: Huang said NVIDIA wants to cut the time to stand up AI factories from months to weeks, a stance underscoring the pace of the infrastructure buildout he is pushing.
body.zh: 黄仁勋表示 NVIDIA 希望把搭建 AI 工厂的时间从数月压缩到数周，凸显他所推动的基础设施建设节奏。

title.en: 黄仁勋发布AI“预制工厂”DSX POD：最快14天部署投产
title.zh: 黄仁勋发布AI“预制工厂”DSX POD：最快14天部署投产

body.en: Huang unveiled DSX POD, a prefabricated 'AI factory' module NVIDIA says customers can deploy and bring online in as little as 14 days.
body.zh: 黄仁勋发布了预制式AI工厂模块DSX POD，英伟达称客户最快可在14天内完成部署并投产。

title.en: Jensen Huang Unveils Five-Layer AI Architecture - THE ELEC, Korea Electronics Industry Media
title.zh: Jensen Huang Unveils Five-Layer AI Architecture - THE ELEC, Korea Electronics Industry Media

body.en: Huang lays out a five-layer AI architecture framework spanning chips to applications, framing NVIDIA's view of how the compute stack should be structured for the AI buildout.
body.zh: 黄仁勋提出涵盖芯片到应用的"五层AI架构"框架，阐述英伟达对AI算力堆栈应如何构建的整体设想。

title.en: 黄仁勋柏林演讲实录：参考人形机器人、AI工厂、CUDA-X、自动驾驶、物理AI、医疗智能体多点发布
title.zh: 黄仁勋柏林演讲实录：参考人形机器人、AI工厂、CUDA-X、自动驾驶、物理AI、医疗智能体多点发布

body.en: In a Berlin keynote, Huang unveiled announcements spanning humanoid robots, AI factories, CUDA-X, autonomous driving, physical AI and medical agents.
body.zh: 黄仁勋在柏林主题演讲中发布了涵盖人形机器人、AI工厂、CUDA-X、自动驾驶、物理AI及医疗智能体的多项新进展。

title.en: 新架构Vera Rubin、RTX Spark电脑、机器人研发进展、自动驾驶车队畅想⋯⋯黄仁勋“2026 GTC”演讲重点速览！
title.zh: 新架构Vera Rubin、RTX Spark电脑、机器人研发进展、自动驾驶车队畅想⋯⋯黄仁勋“2026 GTC”演讲重点速览！

body.en: At GTC 2026 Huang unveiled the new Vera Rubin architecture alongside RTX Spark PCs, robotics and autonomous-driving fleet plans, Nvidia's next major product cycle.
body.zh: 在2026年GTC大会上，黄仁勋发布了全新Vera Rubin架构，并展示了RTX Spark电脑、机器人研发进展及自动驾驶车队规划，这是英伟达下一个重大产品周期。

title.en: 黄仁勋把整个AI数据中心预制了！最快14天盖出AI工厂
title.zh: 黄仁勋把整个AI数据中心预制了！最快14天盖出AI工厂

body.en: Huang unveiled prefabricated AI data centers that NVIDIA says can be built in as little as 14 days, accelerating AI factory rollout.
body.zh: 黄仁勋发布预制式AI数据中心，英伟达称最快14天即可建成，以加速AI工厂的部署。

title.en: How Nvidia's OpenShell is securing the next generation of AI agents: Jensen Huang
title.zh: How Nvidia's OpenShell is securing the next generation of AI agents: Jensen Huang

body.en: Coverage of NVIDIA's new "OpenShell" security offering, pitched by Jensen Huang as protection for the next generation of AI agents.
body.zh: 报道介绍了NVIDIA新推出的“OpenShell”安全产品，黄仁勋将其定位为保护下一代AI智能体的方案。

title.en: 黄仁勋柏林演讲实录：参考人形机器人、AI工厂、CUDA-X、自动驾驶、物理AI、医疗智能体多点发布
title.zh: 黄仁勋柏林演讲实录：参考人形机器人、AI工厂、CUDA-X、自动驾驶、物理AI、医疗智能体多点发布

body.en: At Nvidia's GTC Berlin keynote, Jensen Huang unveiled a wave of launches: a Vera Rubin-based DSX POD AI-factory reference design, a new Agile humanoid robot platform, a CUDA-X developer milestone, and physical-AI and medical-agent initiatives.
body.zh: 黄仁勋在英伟达GTC柏林主题演讲中发布了一系列新品：基于Vera Rubin的DSX POD AI工厂参考设计、新款Agile人形机器人平台、CUDA-X开发者里程碑，以及物理AI与医疗智能体相关计划。

title.en: 黄仁勋当面劝德国总理：德国制造业再不拥抱AI，可能就晚了
title.zh: 黄仁勋当面劝德国总理：德国制造业再不拥抱AI，可能就晚了

body.en: Huang told Germany's Chancellor in person that its manufacturing sector risks falling behind if it doesn't move faster to adopt AI.
body.zh: 黄仁勋当面向德国总理表示，德国制造业若不加快拥抱人工智能，恐将错失机遇。

title.en: 英伟达黄仁勋：AI发展不能急刹车 但必须装“安全带”
title.zh: 英伟达黄仁勋：AI发展不能急刹车 但必须装“安全带”

body.en: Said AI development shouldn't be slammed to a halt but does need a "seatbelt" — guardrails as it accelerates — a notable public stance on AI safety.
body.zh: 表示AI发展不能被急刹车，但必须系好"安全带"，这是他在AI安全议题上的一次公开表态。

title.en: 黄仁勋当面劝德国总理：德国制造业再不拥抱AI，可能就晚了 #黄仁勋 #德国制造业 #人工智能产业 #AI 生态
title.zh: 黄仁勋当面劝德国总理：德国制造业再不拥抱AI，可能就晚了 #黄仁勋 #德国制造业 #人工智能产业 #AI 生态

body.en: Personally urged German Chancellor Merz that German manufacturing risks falling behind if it doesn't embrace AI soon, part of Nvidia's push into Germany.
body.zh: 黄仁勋当面劝说德国总理默茨，称德国制造业若不尽快拥抱AI恐将错失机会，此事与英伟达在德国的布局相关。

title.en: 黄仁勋呼吁为AI设‘安全带’而非急刹车
title.zh: 黄仁勋呼吁为AI设‘安全带’而非急刹车

body.en: Jensen Huang called for AI to be regulated with a "seatbelt" approach rather than an emergency brake, arguing for gradual safety guardrails over abrupt restrictions.
body.zh: 黄仁勋呼吁以"安全带"而非"急刹车"的方式监管AI，主张采取渐进式安全护栏而非骤然限制。

title.en: 黄仁勋：AI发展不能急刹车 但必须装“安全带”
title.zh: 黄仁勋：AI发展不能急刹车 但必须装“安全带”

body.en: Huang reiterated his stance that AI development shouldn't be slammed to a halt but does need safety guardrails — comparing it to seatbelts in cars — continuing his public position in the AI-regulation debate.

title.zh: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang warns Germany is falling behind in AI race

body.en: Huang warned that Germany risks falling behind in the AI race despite its new push into industrial AI.
body.zh: 黄仁勋警告称，尽管德国正大力推动工业AI，但仍有在AI竞赛中落后的风险。

title.en: Jensen Huang Declares NVIDIA Can Win “in the Absence of Any AI Labs”
title.zh: Jensen Huang Declares NVIDIA Can Win “in the Absence of Any AI Labs”

body.en: Huang said NVIDIA can win even if today's major AI labs disappeared, a confident stance on how durable the company's position is.
body.zh: 黄仁勋表示，即便当今主要的AI实验室都消失，英伟达依然能赢得这场竞争，体现了他对公司地位的自信判断。

title.en: 黄仁勋2025最新对话实录：未来属于将物理世界与人工智能结合的人 定义下一个AI时代
title.zh: 黄仁勋2025最新对话实录：未来属于将物理世界与人工智能结合的人 定义下一个AI时代

body.en: In an extended conversation, Huang argued the next era of AI belongs to those who combine the physical world with artificial intelligence.
body.zh: 黄仁勋在一次长谈中提出，下一个AI时代属于能将物理世界与人工智能结合起来的人。

title.en: Jensen Huang: “Two Gigawatts to Us Is Like $80 Billion.” 43 New Gigawatts Coming in 2027
title.zh: Jensen Huang: “Two Gigawatts to Us Is Like $80 Billion.” 43 New Gigawatts Coming in 2027

body.en: Huang quantified NVIDIA's scale, saying two gigawatts of compute equates to $80 billion and that 43 new gigawatts of capacity are coming in 2027 — a concrete data point on the pace of the AI buildout.
body.zh: 黄仁勋给出具体数据：两吉瓦算力相当于800亿美元，2027年将新增43吉瓦产能——这是AI基础设施建设速度的一个具体量化指标。

title.en: 黄仁勋在2026年GTC柏林大会上的主题演讲
title.zh: 黄仁勋在2026年GTC柏林大会上的主题演讲

body.en: Huang delivered the keynote address at NVIDIA's GTC Berlin 2026 conference.
body.zh: 黄仁勋在英伟达2026年GTC柏林大会上发表主题演讲。

title.en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang rejects Sam Altman's AI cybersecurity trade-off argument
title.zh: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang rejects Sam Altman's AI cybersecurity trade-off argument

body.en: Huang publicly rejected Altman's argument that AI progress requires trading off cybersecurity safeguards, a direct disagreement between two of the industry's most influential figures.
body.zh: 黄仁勋公开反驳了奥特曼关于AI发展需要在网络安全保障上做出取舍的观点，这是两位行业最具影响力人物之间的直接分歧。

title.en: 黄仁勋盛：首款英伟达芯微软PC“难以置信”
title.zh: 黄仁勋盛：首款英伟达芯微软PC“难以置信”

body.en: Jensen Huang called the first Nvidia-chip Windows PC, built with Microsoft, "unbelievable," marking Nvidia's push into PC silicon alongside its GPU business.
body.zh: 黄仁勋称首款搭载英伟达芯片、与微软合作打造的PC"难以置信"，标志着英伟达在GPU业务之外进军PC芯片市场。

title.en: Elon Musk Says Jensen Huang 'Rocks' as SpaceX, Nvidia Team Up on AI Data Centers in Space: ‘Far Better Than Almost Anyone Expects’
title.zh: Elon Musk Says Jensen Huang 'Rocks' as SpaceX, Nvidia Team Up on AI Data Centers in Space: ‘Far Better Than Almost Anyone Expects’

body.en: Elon Musk publicly praised Jensen Huang as NVIDIA and SpaceX announced a partnership to build AI data centers in space.
body.zh: 埃隆·马斯克公开赞扬黄仁勋，同时SpaceX与英伟达宣布合作在太空建设AI数据中心。

title.en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang ‘strongly’ disagrees with OpenAI’s Sam Altman on AI agents hacking websites, ‘I’m
title.zh: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang ‘strongly’ disagrees with OpenAI’s Sam Altman on AI agents hacking websites, ‘I’m

body.en: Huang publicly said he strongly disagrees with Sam Altman's comments about AI agents hacking websites.
body.zh: 黄仁勋公开表示强烈不同意Sam Altman关于AI代理入侵网站的言论。

title.en: 为何推理算力需暴涨十亿倍？：黄仁勋深度拆解AI慢思考逻辑
title.zh: 为何推理算力需暴涨十亿倍？：黄仁勋深度拆解AI慢思考逻辑

body.en: Huang argues inference compute needs to scale up a billion-fold, laying out his reasoning on AI's 'slow thinking' demands.
body.zh: 黄仁勋认为推理算力需要暴涨十亿倍，并详细阐述了AI“慢思考”所需算力的逻辑。

title.en: 物理AI才是终局：黄仁勋：机器人市场将超千亿
title.zh: 物理AI才是终局：黄仁勋：机器人市场将超千亿

body.en: Huang calls physical AI the ultimate endgame and projects the robotics market will exceed $100B.
body.zh: 黄仁勋称物理AI才是终局，并预测机器人市场规模将超千亿（美元级）。

title.en: 如何控制超越人类的AI？：黄仁勋提零信任监控原则
title.zh: 如何控制超越人类的AI？：黄仁勋提零信任监控原则

body.en: Huang proposes a 'zero trust' monitoring principle as the way to control AI that surpasses human capability.
body.zh: 黄仁勋提出以“零信任”监控原则来控制超越人类能力的AI。

title.en: 黄仁勋硬核回应AI末日论：称低估人类是一种狂妄
title.zh: 黄仁勋硬核回应AI末日论：称低估人类是一种狂妄

body.en: Huang pushes back hard on AI doomsday predictions, saying underestimating humanity is a form of arrogance.
body.zh: 黄仁勋强硬回应AI末日论，称低估人类是一种狂妄。

title.en: Jensen Huang Says Nvidia Could Cut Off Chip Supply to Unsafe AI Developers, Pledges $250 Million in UK Safety Research Resources
title.zh: Jensen Huang Says Nvidia Could Cut Off Chip Supply to Unsafe AI Developers, Pledges $250 Million in UK Safety Research Resources

body.en: Jensen Huang said Nvidia could cut off chip supply to AI developers it judges unsafe and pledged $250 million toward UK AI safety research, putting Nvidia's hardware leverage behind a safety-enforcement stance.
body.zh: 黄仁勋表示，英伟达可能对其认定为不安全的AI开发者停止供应芯片，并承诺向英国AI安全研究投入2.5亿美元，首次将芯片影响力用作安全执行手段。

title.en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang says America must work with China on AI safety; says ‘The US should …’
title.zh: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang says America must work with China on AI safety; says ‘The US should …’

body.en: Jensen Huang said the US should work with China on AI safety rather than treat it as a purely competitive race.
body.zh: 黄仁勋表示美国应在AI安全问题上与中国合作，而非仅将其视为单纯的竞争。

title.en: 黄仁勋称AI市场震荡将会过去，密集欧洲行持续释放信心
title.zh: 黄仁勋称AI市场震荡将会过去，密集欧洲行持续释放信心

body.en: Huang said the AI market's turbulence will pass, delivering that reassurance during an intensive tour of Europe.
body.zh: 黄仁勋表示AI市场的震荡终将过去，他在密集的欧洲行期间持续传递这一信心。

title.en: Jensen Huang Recalls How a Single Return Call Saved Nvidia: On TSMC's Origins and Why 'Restrictions Are the Mother of Invention' for Chinese AI Firms
title.zh: Jensen Huang Recalls How a Single Return Call Saved Nvidia: On TSMC's Origins and Why 'Restrictions Are the Mother of Invention' for Chinese AI Firms

body.en: Jensen Huang said export restrictions are driving Chinese AI firms to innovate, while recounting how an early phone call with TSMC helped save Nvidia.
body.zh: 黄仁勋表示，出口限制正推动中国AI企业加速创新，并讲述了一次与台积电的早期通话如何帮助挽救了英伟达。

title.en: 英伟达黄仁勋称AI现在不是泡沫，安全不应成减速理由
title.zh: 英伟达黄仁勋称AI现在不是泡沫，安全不应成减速理由

body.en: Jensen Huang said AI is not currently a bubble and that safety concerns should not be used as a reason to slow its development.
body.zh: 黄仁勋表示，AI目前并非泡沫，安全问题不应成为减缓其发展的理由。

title.en: ‘He was once my intern’: Jensen Huang’s introduction of Black Forest Labs CEO goes viral - WATCH
title.zh: ‘He was once my intern’: Jensen Huang’s introduction of Black Forest Labs CEO goes viral - WATCH

body.en: Huang's introduction of Black Forest Labs CEO as 'once my intern' went viral, a small but telling marker of NVIDIA's reach into the AI startup ecosystem.
body.zh: 黄仁勋在介绍Black Forest Labs CEO时提到“他曾是我的实习生”，这段话走红网络，侧面反映出NVIDIA在AI创业圈的影响力。

title.en: ‘All of this is going to pass’: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang on AI market turmoil
title.zh: ‘All of this is going to pass’: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang on AI market turmoil

body.en: Amid a sharp NVIDIA stock slide tied to AI-market jitters, Huang publicly dismissed the turmoil as temporary, saying 'all of this is going to pass.'
body.zh: 在NVIDIA股价因AI市场担忧大幅下滑之际，黄仁勋公开表示这种动荡只是暂时的，称“一切都会过去”。

title.en: 英伟达黄仁勋称AI现在不是泡沫，安全不应成减速理由
title.zh: 英伟达黄仁勋称AI现在不是泡沫，安全不应成减速理由

body.en: Huang said AI is not currently in a bubble and that safety concerns should not be used as a reason to slow development, a public stance in the ongoing AI-bubble debate.
body.zh: 黄仁勋表示，当前AI并未处于泡沫之中，安全问题不应成为放慢发展的理由——这是他在当前AI泡沫争论中的公开表态。

title.en: 黄仁勋最新表态：这一切都会过去
title.zh: 黄仁勋最新表态：这一切都会过去

body.en: Amid a chip-stock selloff that wiped out trillions in Nvidia's market value, Huang publicly reassured that AI's fundamentals haven't changed and "this will all pass."
body.zh: 在芯片股大跌、英伟达市值蒸发数万亿美元之际，黄仁勋公开表态称AI行业基本面没有变化，“这一切都会过去”。

title.en: 英伟达市值，9天蒸发4万亿元，黄仁勋很乐观：这一切都会过去
title.zh: 英伟达市值，9天蒸发4万亿元，黄仁勋很乐观：这一切都会过去

body.en: After Nvidia's market cap fell by roughly 4 trillion yuan over nine days, Huang struck a public note of optimism, saying the downturn will pass.
body.zh: 英伟达市值9天内蒸发约4万亿元人民币后，黄仁勋公开表示乐观，称这一切都会过去。

title.en: Jensen Huang says U.S. must welcome foreign talent amid Trump H-1B curbs
title.zh: Jensen Huang says U.S. must welcome foreign talent amid Trump H-1B curbs

body.en: Huang said the US must keep welcoming foreign talent even as the Trump administration tightens H-1B visa rules, warning restrictions would hurt the chip and AI industry.
body.zh: 黄仁勋表示，即使特朗普政府收紧H-1B签证政策，美国仍必须继续欢迎外国人才，否则将损害芯片和AI产业。

title.en: 黄仁勋：所有客户抢着买英伟达芯片，我却不断让他们失望
title.zh: 黄仁勋：所有客户抢着买英伟达芯片，我却不断让他们失望

body.en: Huang said every customer is scrambling to buy Nvidia chips and that he keeps having to disappoint them, underscoring how supply-constrained demand remains.
body.zh: 黄仁勋表示所有客户都在抢购英伟达芯片，而他却不断让他们失望，凸显出芯片供应仍远跟不上需求。

title.en: 英伟达黄仁勋：AI芯片供不应求 订单几乎每日持续涌入
title.zh: 英伟达黄仁勋：AI芯片供不应求 订单几乎每日持续涌入

body.en: Huang said NVIDIA AI chip orders continue to outstrip supply, pushing back on narratives of a slowdown.
body.zh: 黄仁勋表示英伟达AI芯片订单持续供不应求，反驳了需求放缓的说法。

title.en: 黄仁勋亲自站台！沃尔沃联手英伟达搞自动驾驶：老牌车企要翻盘
title.zh: 黄仁勋亲自站台！沃尔沃联手英伟达搞自动驾驶：老牌车企要翻盘

body.en: Huang personally backed a new Nvidia-Volvo partnership to build autonomous-driving systems, extending Nvidia's push into automotive compute.
body.zh: 黄仁勋亲自为英伟达与沃尔沃的自动驾驶合作站台，进一步拓展英伟达在汽车计算领域的布局。

title.en: 黄仁勋称全球基建年投入或达4万亿美元，与联想集团合作应对算力瓶颈
title.zh: 黄仁勋称全球基建年投入或达4万亿美元，与联想集团合作应对算力瓶颈

body.en: Huang forecast global AI infrastructure spending could reach $4 trillion a year and announced a partnership with Lenovo to address compute bottlenecks.
body.zh: 黄仁勋预测全球AI基建年投入可能达到4万亿美元，并宣布与联想合作以应对算力瓶颈问题。

title.en: 黄仁勋：应与中国 AI 企业对话合作，管控 AI 风险 - Malaysia-China Insight
title.zh: 黄仁勋：应与中国 AI 企业对话合作，管控 AI 风险 - Malaysia-China Insight

body.en: Huang called for dialogue and cooperation with Chinese AI companies to manage AI risk, a notable stance on US-China AI relations.
body.zh: 黄仁勋呼吁与中国AI企业展开对话与合作以管控AI风险，这是他在中美AI关系上的一次重要表态。

title.en: 黄仁勋：绝对必须与中国人工智能公司合作
title.zh: 黄仁勋：绝对必须与中国人工智能公司合作

body.en: Huang said Nvidia must work with Chinese AI companies, will cut off chip supply to customers building unsafe AI, and expects the AI infrastructure shortage to persist for years.
body.zh: 黄仁勋表示英伟达必须与中国人工智能公司合作，将对开发不安全AI的客户断供芯片，并预计AI基础设施短缺将持续数年。

title.en: 黄仁勋称全球基建年投入或达4万亿美元，与联想集团合作应对算力瓶颈_公司新闻_财经
title.zh: 黄仁勋称全球基建年投入或达4万亿美元，与联想集团合作应对算力瓶颈_公司新闻_财经

body.en: Huang forecast global AI infrastructure spending could reach $4 trillion a year and announced a partnership with Lenovo to address compute bottlenecks.
body.zh: 黄仁勋预测全球AI基建年投入或达4万亿美元，并宣布与联想集团合作应对算力瓶颈问题。

title.en: 黄仁勋谈AI安全：主张零容忍，安全应靠技术防护而非新增监管 英伟达首席执行官*「AI技术完全处于我们的控制之中，企业若无法保证不越界，就不应将其推向市场」*在伦敦接受《财富》采访时表示
title.zh: 黄仁勋谈AI安全：主张零容忍，安全应靠技术防护而非新增监管 英伟达首席执行官*「AI技术完全处于我们的控制之中，企业若无法保证不越界，就不应将其推向市场」*在伦敦接受《财富》采访时表示

body.en: In a Fortune interview in London, Huang argued AI safety should rest on zero-tolerance technical safeguards rather than new regulation.
body.zh: 黄仁勋在伦敦接受《财富》采访时表示，AI安全应依靠技术防护实现零容忍，而非依赖新增监管。

title.en: 英伟达CEO黄仁勋：AI网络安全应做到“零事故”，反驳OepnAI CEO奥尔特曼立场
title.zh: 英伟达CEO黄仁勋：AI网络安全应做到“零事故”，反驳OepnAI CEO奥尔特曼立场

body.en: Huang said AI chipmakers must achieve "zero incidents" on cybersecurity, pushing back on OpenAI CEO Sam Altman's stance on the issue.
body.zh: 黄仁勋表示AI芯片厂商必须在网络安全上做到"零事故"，对OpenAI首席执行官奥尔特曼的立场提出反驳。

title.en: 黄仁勋：芯片厂商必须与中国AI企业合作，共同监控AI潜在风险
title.zh: 黄仁勋：芯片厂商必须与中国AI企业合作，共同监控AI潜在风险

body.en: Huang said chipmakers must cooperate with Chinese AI firms to jointly monitor AI risk, staking a position in the US-China AI chip debate.
body.zh: 黄仁勋表示芯片厂商必须与中国AI企业合作，共同监控AI潜在风险，就中美AI芯片议题表明立场。

title.en: Jensen Huang on agents gone rogue and AI doomers
title.zh: Jensen Huang on agents gone rogue and AI doomers

body.en: Huang pushed back on AI-doomer narratives and discussed the risks of agents acting unpredictably, a public stance in the AI safety debate.
body.zh: 黄仁勋反驳了AI末日论的说法，并讨论了智能体行为失控的风险，这是他在AI安全争论中的公开表态。

title.en: Jensen Huang on BG2: the capex math that beats the bubble case
title.zh: Jensen Huang on BG2: the capex math that beats the bubble case

body.en: On the BG2 podcast, Huang argued NVIDIA's capex economics undercut the AI-bubble thesis, defending the scale of current AI infrastructure spending.
body.zh: 黄仁勋在BG2节目中表示，英伟达的资本支出经济学反驳了AI泡沫论，为当前AI基础设施投资规模进行辩护。

title.en: 黄仁勋的第一条X推文，开源模型为何如此重要？
title.zh: 黄仁勋的第一条X推文，开源模型为何如此重要？

body.en: In his first post on X, Huang explained why open-source models matter, a notable public stance from NVIDIA's CEO on open AI development.
body.zh: 黄仁勋在X平台发出第一条推文，阐述了开源模型为何重要，是英伟达CEO对开放AI发展的一次重要公开表态。

title.en: Elon Musk Says Jensen Huang 'Rocks' as SpaceX, Nvidia Team Up on AI Data Centers in Space: ‘Far Better Th
title.zh: Elon Musk Says Jensen Huang 'Rocks' as SpaceX, Nvidia Team Up on AI Data Centers in Space: ‘Far Better Th

body.en: Elon Musk said Nvidia and SpaceX are teaming up to build AI data centers in space, praising Huang.
body.zh: 埃隆·马斯克表示SpaceX与英伟达正合作在太空建设AI数据中心，并称赞黄仁勋。

title.en: 黄仁勋谈AI安全：主张零容忍，安全应靠技术防护而非新增监管
title.zh: 黄仁勋谈AI安全：主张零容忍，安全应靠技术防护而非新增监管

body.en: Huang argued AI safety should rest on zero-tolerance technical safeguards rather than new regulation.
body.zh: 黄仁勋主张AI安全应坚持零容忍，依靠技术防护而非新增监管来实现。

title.en: 黄仁勋:缺乏成长文化 “英国丢失创业精神”
title.zh: 黄仁勋:缺乏成长文化 “英国丢失创业精神”

body.en: Huang said in a talk that the UK lacks a growth culture and has lost its entrepreneurial spirit, a public critique of the startup environment there.
body.zh: 黄仁勋在一次演讲中表示英国缺乏成长文化、已经丢失了创业精神，这是他对英国创业环境的公开评价。

title.en: ‘We’re creating alien beings’: Geoffrey Hinton answers Jensen Huang
title.zh: ‘We’re creating alien beings’: Geoffrey Hinton answers Jensen Huang

body.en: Huang's remarks on AI progress drew a public rebuttal from Geoffrey Hinton, who called current systems 'alien beings' in a high-profile exchange on AI risk.
body.zh: 黄仁勋关于AI发展的言论引来Geoffrey Hinton的公开反驳,后者称当前系统是"异形生命体",这是两人之间一次引人关注的AI风险交锋。

title.en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang defends CoreWeave as default risk rises
title.zh: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang defends CoreWeave as default risk rises

body.en: Jensen Huang publicly defended CoreWeave against rising default-risk concerns, a notable stance given Nvidia's deep financial and supply ties to the cloud provider.
body.zh: 黄仁勋公开为CoreWeave的违约风险担忧进行辩护，鉴于英伟达与这家云服务商在财务和供应链上的深度关联，这一表态值得关注。

title.en: 黄仁勋亲自站台！沃尔沃联手英伟达搞自动驾驶：老牌车企要翻盘
title.zh: 黄仁勋亲自站台！沃尔沃联手英伟达搞自动驾驶：老牌车企要翻盘

body.en: Jensen Huang personally backed a new Volvo–NVIDIA partnership to build autonomous-driving technology, extending NVIDIA's push into automotive AI.
body.zh: 黄仁勋亲自站台沃尔沃与英伟达的自动驾驶技术合作，延续英伟达在汽车AI领域的布局。

title.en: Germany plans AI partnership with Jensen Huang’s Nvidia
title.zh: Germany plans AI partnership with Jensen Huang’s Nvidia

body.en: Germany announces plans for an AI partnership with Nvidia, extending Huang's influence over which nations get access to frontier compute.
body.zh: 德国宣布计划与英伟达建立AI合作伙伴关系,进一步扩大黄仁勋在各国获取前沿算力方面的影响力。

title.en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Rejects Sam Altman's Advice to 'Accept' AI Cybersecurity Risks: ‘We Should Do Everything...to Avoid Them’
title.zh: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Rejects Sam Altman's Advice to 'Accept' AI Cybersecurity Risks: ‘We Should Do Everything...to Avoid Them’

body.en: Huang publicly rejected Sam Altman's suggestion that AI cybersecurity risks should simply be accepted, saying Nvidia will do everything possible to avoid them.
body.zh: 黄仁勋公开反对萨姆·奥特曼"应接受AI网络安全风险"的说法，表示英伟达将尽一切努力去避免这些风险。

title.en: Jensen Huang tells Lex Fridman export controls should be ‘extremely selective’
title.zh: Jensen Huang tells Lex Fridman export controls should be ‘extremely selective’

body.en: Huang told Lex Fridman that export controls on AI chips should be applied narrowly and selectively rather than broadly, a notable policy stance from NVIDIA's CEO.
body.zh: 黄仁勋在接受Lex Fridman采访时表示，对AI芯片的出口管制应高度精准、有选择性，而非一概而论，这是英伟达CEO在政策议题上的重要表态。

title.en: Nvidia’s Jensen Huang says AI may need a billion times more compute
title.zh: Nvidia’s Jensen Huang says AI may need a billion times more compute

body.en: Huang said the AI industry may eventually need a billion times more compute than today, underscoring NVIDIA's long-term bullish case for continued scaling.
body.zh: 黄仁勋表示AI行业未来可能需要比现在多十亿倍的算力，凸显英伟达对算力持续扩张的长期乐观判断。

body.en: Huang told CNBC that Nvidia must work with Chinese AI companies on safety, a notable public stance on US-China AI cooperation amid export-control tensions.

body.zh: 黄仁勋公开在移民政策上与特朗普政府立场不同，主张美国应吸纳全球顶尖人才以保持其AI领先优势。

body.en: After meeting French president Macron, Jensen Huang signaled a push to invest in Europe's AI ecosystem and rally the AI industry coalition around NVIDIA's platform.
body.zh: 黄仁勋在会见法国总统马克龙后，表示将加大对欧洲人工智能生态的投资，并为AI阵营“拉群”。

body.en: NVIDIA announced an additional $2 billion investment in Europe, including stakes in four French AI startups, deepening its push into the region.
body.zh: 英伟达宣布在欧洲追加20亿美元投资，并投资四家法国人工智能初创公司，加码布局欧洲市场。

body.zh: 黄仁勋宣布英伟达将在欧洲追加20亿美元投资，并表示"欧洲需要加入这场竞赛"，凸显公司在当地扩大AI基础设施产能的举措。

title.zh: Nvidia's Jensen Huang announces plans to invest US$2 bn in Europe

body.en: Jensen Huang announced a new NVIDIA investment in France, extending the company's European footprint as it allocates compute capacity globally.
body.zh: 黄仁勋宣布英伟达在法国进行新投资，在全球分配算力产能的同时扩大公司在欧洲的布局。

body.zh: 中国国务院副总理丁薛祥会见了英伟达的黄仁勋和AMD的苏姿丰，凸显两家芯片公司对中国市场的持续投入。

title.zh: Nvidia's Jensen Huang pledges $2 billion for Europe, $250 million in compute for UK safety labs

body.zh: 黄仁勋承诺向欧洲投资20亿美元，并为英国AI安全实验室提供2.5亿美元的算力支持。

title.zh: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang 'optimistic' on AI risks, sovereignty and jobs

body.en: Huang struck an optimistic tone on AI risks, sovereignty and jobs, outlining his view on how the technology's downsides can be managed.
body.zh: 黄仁勋就人工智能风险、主权和就业问题表达了乐观态度，阐述了他对如何应对技术负面影响的看法。

title.zh: Jensen Huang said Nvidia would stop supplying chips to unsafe AI developers

body.zh: 黄仁勋表示NVIDIA将停止向其认定不安全的AI开发者供应芯片，将GPU分配与安全行为挂钩。

title.en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang says he would cut off customers who build unsafe AI
title.zh: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang says he would cut off customers who build unsafe AI

body.en: Jensen Huang said Nvidia would cut off chip supply to customers building unsafe AI, though only after discussion first — a notable public stance on AI safety from the industry's dominant hardware supplier.
body.zh: 黄仁勋表示，英伟达将对开发不安全AI的客户断供芯片，但会先行沟通——作为行业主导硬件供应商，这是一次值得关注的AI安全表态。

title.en: Nvidia's Jensen Huang responds to Pope Leo's AI safety criticism—'We all care about the same thing'
title.zh: Nvidia's Jensen Huang responds to Pope Leo's AI safety criticism—'We all care about the same thing'

body.en: Huang publicly responded to Pope Leo's criticism of AI safety, saying 'we all care about the same thing' — a notable public exchange on AI safety concerns.
body.zh: 黄仁勋公开回应教皇良十四世对AI安全的批评，表示“我们都关心同一件事”，这是一次关于AI安全问题的引人关注的公开交流。

title.en: 英伟达CEO黄仁勋称会对开发不安全AI软件的客户断供芯片
title.zh: 英伟达CEO黄仁勋称会对开发不安全AI软件的客户断供芯片

body.en: Huang said NVIDIA would cut off chip supply to customers it found developing unsafe AI software (after warning them first), and announced $250M over five years to fund UK AI-safety research — tying NVIDIA's chokepoint position directly to AI-safety enforcement.
body.zh: 黄仁勋表示，若发现客户开发不安全的AI软件，英伟达会在先行沟通后停止供应芯片，并宣布未来五年投入2.5亿美元支持英国的AI安全研究，将英伟达在算力上的话语权与AI安全监管直接挂钩。

title.en: 黄仁勋：客户若开发不安全AI 将停止向其供应芯片

body.zh: 黄仁勋表示，若客户开发不安全的AI，英伟达将停止向其供应芯片，将芯片供应与安全承诺挂钩。

title.en: 英伟达黄仁勋：对开发不安全AI软件的客户断供芯片

body.zh: 黄仁勋表示，若客户开发不安全的AI软件，英伟达将停止供应芯片——这是将芯片供应与AI安全承诺挂钩的公开表态。

title.en: 英伟达黄仁勋：若客户开发不安全AI软件，极端措施可断供芯片

body.en: Huang said NVIDIA could cut off chip supply to customers that develop 'unsafe' AI software, tying NVIDIA's commercial leverage to AI-safety behavior across the industry.
body.zh: 黄仁勋表示，若客户开发“不安全”的AI软件，英伟达可能切断芯片供应——这一表态将英伟达的商业影响力与全行业的AI安全行为挂钩，意义重大。

title.en: 黄仁勋：对不安全企业停供芯片 市场对AI忧虑过分放大 - https://www.hkong.cn/
title.zh: 黄仁勋：对不安全企业停供芯片 市场对AI忧虑过分放大 - https://www.hkong.cn/

body.en: Huang said NVIDIA would cut off chip supply to companies deemed unsafe and that the market is overestimating AI risk, a notable policy stance.
body.zh: 黄仁勋表示将对不安全的企业停止供应芯片，并称市场对AI风险的担忧被过分放大，这是他在相关政策上的重要表态。

title.en: 辛顿回怼黄仁勋：AI灭绝人类的概率，是10%到20%

body.zh: 黄仁勋与马斯克、库克、苏姿丰一同坐在白宫欢迎习近平国宴的主桌，凸显其在行业中的核心地位。

title.en: 英伟达黄仁勋：AI“监管豁免”没有道理，外界对AI的担忧已过度
title.zh: 英伟达黄仁勋：AI“监管豁免”没有道理，外界对AI的担忧已过度

body.en: Jensen Huang argued publicly that AI 'regulatory exemptions' make no sense and that outside fears about AI have become excessive.
body.zh: 黄仁勋公开表示，所谓AI"监管豁免"没有道理，外界对AI的担忧已经过度。

title.en: Nvidia’s Jensen Huang on the true threat of AI
title.zh: Nvidia’s Jensen Huang on the true threat of AI

body.en: In a CNN interview, Jensen Huang laid out his view of the real risks posed by AI, as NVIDIA's allocation decisions increasingly shape who can train frontier models.
body.zh: 黄仁勋在CNN采访中阐述了他认为AI真正的风险所在，此时英伟达的算力分配决策正日益左右谁能训练前沿模型。

title.en: 黄仁勋驳斥AI恐慌论，称技术转型将开启“人类雄心”新时代！
title.zh: 黄仁勋驳斥AI恐慌论，称技术转型将开启“人类雄心”新时代！

body.en: Jensen Huang publicly rejected AI-panic narratives, arguing the technology shift will usher in a new era of human ambition — a notable public stance on AI's societal impact.
body.zh: 黄仁勋公开驳斥AI恐慌论，称这场技术转型将开启人类雄心的新时代——这是他就AI社会影响发表的一次重要公开表态。

title.en: Jensen Huang Rejects Legal Waivers for AI Labs
title.zh: Jensen Huang Rejects Legal Waivers for AI Labs

body.en: Jensen Huang publicly rejected the idea of legal liability waivers for AI labs, staking out a position on AI industry accountability.
body.zh: 黄仁勋公开反对为AI实验室提供法律责任豁免，就AI行业问责问题表明立场。

title.en: Jensen Huang says AI labs that can't control their systems should shut down
title.zh: Jensen Huang says AI labs that can't control their systems should shut down

body.en: Jensen Huang said AI labs that cannot keep their systems under control should shut down, a pointed stance on AI safety and oversight.
body.zh: 黄仁勋表示，无法控制自身系统的AI实验室应当关闭，这是他就AI安全与监管问题表明的鲜明立场。

title.en: Jensen Huang Says AI Boom Will Eventually Hit a 'Period of Digestion,' But Not for 2-3 Years
title.zh: Jensen Huang Says AI Boom Will Eventually Hit a 'Period of Digestion,' But Not for 2-3 Years

body.en: Huang predicts the AI investment boom will eventually hit a 'period of digestion,' but not for another 2-3 years — a closely watched read on the AI capex cycle from NVIDIA's CEO.
body.zh: 黄仁勋预测AI投资热潮终将进入"消化期"，但认为这至少还要2到3年——作为英伟达CEO，他对AI资本开支周期的判断备受关注。

title.en: 马斯克、黄仁勋判断惊人一致：中国2030年前后依靠自己光刻技术补齐算力缺口
title.zh: 马斯克、黄仁勋判断惊人一致：中国2030年前后依靠自己光刻技术补齐算力缺口

body.en: Huang said he shares Musk's view that China will close its compute gap via homegrown lithography by around 2030 — a substantive public read on the chip export-control landscape.
body.zh: 黄仁勋表示他与马斯克看法一致，认为中国将在2030年前后依靠自主光刻技术补齐算力缺口，这是对芯片出口管制格局的一次实质性公开判断。

title.en: 黄仁勋谈对华竞争：我喜欢中国这一点
title.zh: 黄仁勋谈对华竞争：我喜欢中国这一点

body.en: Huang said he 'likes' aspects of competing with China, opposed granting AI firms antitrust and product-liability exemptions, and dismissed AI-doomsday warnings as a smokescreen for evading regulation.
body.zh: 黄仁勋表示自己喜欢与中国竞争的这一点，反对给予AI企业反垄断和产品责任豁免，并称AI末日论是逃避监管的烟雾弹。

title.en: 奥特曼、阿莫迪向联合国呼吁放缓AI确保安全，黄仁勋反对任何企业获得监管豁免
title.zh: 奥特曼、阿莫迪向联合国呼吁放缓AI确保安全，黄仁勋反对任何企业获得监管豁免

body.en: While Altman and Amodei called on the UN to slow AI development for safety, Huang publicly opposed any company getting regulatory exemptions — a stance in the ongoing AI-safety-regulation debate.
body.zh: 在奥特曼和阿莫迪呼吁联合国放缓AI发展以确保安全之际，黄仁勋公开表示反对任何企业获得监管豁免，这是他在AI安全监管争论中的公开立场。

title.en: AI firms should not get regulatory waivers, says Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang
title.zh: AI firms should not get regulatory waivers, says Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang

body.en: Huang argued AI companies should not receive regulatory waivers or antitrust exemptions.
body.zh: 黄仁勋表示AI公司不应获得监管豁免或反垄断豁免。

title.en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang on AI doomsday warnings from Dario Amodei, Sam Altman and others: Don’t think for
title.zh: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang on AI doomsday warnings from Dario Amodei, Sam Altman and others: Don’t think for

body.en: Huang pushed back on AI-doomsday warnings from Dario Amodei, Sam Altman and others.
body.zh: 黄仁勋回应了阿莫迪、奥特曼等人发出的AI末日警告，对其论调提出异议。

title.en: World's Most Powerful AI University Officially Established: Sam Altman Appointed Lecturer, Jensen Huang & Satya Nadella Line Up to Show Support
title.zh: World's Most Powerful AI University Officially Established: Sam Altman Appointed Lecturer, Jensen Huang & Satya Nadella Line Up to Show Support

body.en: Huang and Satya Nadella publicly backed the launch of a new AI-focused university, where Sam Altman was named a lecturer.
body.zh: 黄仁勋与萨提亚·纳德拉公开支持一所新AI大学的成立，萨姆·奥特曼受聘为讲师。

title.en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Says AI Labs Should 'Shut Down' If They Can't Control Their Systems: Bernie Sanders Says His Bill 'Would Do Just That'
title.zh: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Says AI Labs Should 'Shut Down' If They Can't Control Their Systems: Bernie Sanders Says His Bill 'Would Do Just That'

body.en: Jensen Huang said AI labs should be shut down if they can't control their systems, weighing in on Bernie Sanders' proposed AI oversight bill.
body.zh: 黄仁勋表示，如果AI实验室无法控制自身系统就应当被关停，并就伯尼·桑德斯提出的AI监管法案表态。

title.en: 黄仁勋再谈AI风险称巨头自己需对产品安全负责
title.zh: 黄仁勋再谈AI风险称巨头自己需对产品安全负责

body.en: Huang said AI giants themselves must be responsible for product safety, restating his view that industry self-regulation should lead on AI risk.
body.zh: 黄仁勋表示，AI巨头自身需要对产品安全负责，重申了应由行业自律主导AI风险治理的立场。

title.en: 黄仁勋接受纽约时报专访：AI风险应被工程化处理，而非神秘化
title.zh: 黄仁勋接受纽约时报专访：AI风险应被工程化处理，而非神秘化

body.en: In a New York Times interview, Huang argued AI risk should be handled through engineering discipline rather than treated as mystical or existential.
body.zh: 黄仁勋在接受《纽约时报》专访时表示，AI风险应通过工程化方式处理，而非被神秘化。

title.en: 黄仁勋称外界对AI担忧过度，AI企业应自行测试确认安全
title.zh: 黄仁勋称外界对AI担忧过度，AI企业应自行测试确认安全

body.en: Argued that outside concerns about AI are overblown and that AI companies should self-test to confirm safety, pushing back on calls for heavier regulation.
body.zh: 表示外界对AI的担忧过度，AI企业应自行测试确认安全，反对加强监管的呼声。

title.en: 马斯克、黄仁勋判断惊人一致：中国2030年前后依靠自己光刻技术补齐算力缺口
title.zh: 马斯克、黄仁勋判断惊人一致：中国2030年前后依靠自己光刻技术补齐算力缺口

body.en: Agreed with Elon Musk that China will close its compute gap by relying on its own lithography technology by around 2030.
body.zh: 与马斯克看法一致，认为中国将在2030年前后依靠自主光刻技术补齐算力缺口。

title.en: 黄仁勋：反对为AI行业开放反垄断及产品责任法豁免的特权
title.zh: 黄仁勋：反对为AI行业开放反垄断及产品责任法豁免的特权

body.en: Opposed giving the AI industry special exemptions from antitrust and product-liability law.
body.zh: 反对为AI行业开放反垄断和产品责任法方面的豁免特权。

title.en: Jensen Huang warned that AI labs unable to contain their models should shut down
title.zh: Jensen Huang warned that AI labs unable to contain their models should shut down

body.en: Huang said AI labs unable to contain their models should be shut down, a notably blunt safety stance from an industry leader who usually downplays existential-risk talk.
body.zh: 黄仁勋表示，无法控制自身模型的AI实验室应当被关停，这是一位通常淡化AI存在性风险论调的行业领袖罕见的强硬安全表态。

title.en: 黄仁勋公开表态：反对为AI行业开放反垄断及产品责任法豁免的特权
title.zh: 黄仁勋公开表态：反对为AI行业开放反垄断及产品责任法豁免的特权

body.en: Huang publicly opposed giving the AI industry blanket antitrust and product-liability exemptions, arguing safety risks should be engineered around rather than regulated away.
body.zh: 黄仁勋公开反对为AI行业开放反垄断及产品责任法的豁免特权，主张安全风险应通过工程手段解决，而非依靠监管豁免。

title.en: Jensen Huang Says AI Boom Will Eventually Hit a 'Period of Digestion,' But Not for 2-3 Years
title.zh: Jensen Huang Says AI Boom Will Eventually Hit a 'Period of Digestion,' But Not for 2-3 Years

body.en: Jensen Huang said the AI boom will eventually hit a 'period of digestion,' but not for another two to three years.
body.zh: 黄仁勋表示AI热潮最终将进入“消化期”，但这一情况在未来两三年内不会发生。

title.en: 黄仁勋：AI企业不应寻求反垄断与产品责任法豁免
title.zh: 黄仁勋：AI企业不应寻求反垄断与产品责任法豁免

body.en: Jensen Huang argued AI companies should not seek exemptions from antitrust and product-liability law.
body.zh: 黄仁勋表示AI企业不应寻求反垄断与产品责任法方面的豁免。

title.en: Jensen Huang: China's tech success is great for the US
title.zh: Jensen Huang: China's tech success is great for the US

body.en: Jensen Huang said China's tech success benefits the US too, a notable public stance on US-China tech competition.
body.zh: 黄仁勋表示中国科技的成功对美国也有利，这是他在中美科技竞争议题上的重要公开表态。

title.en: 夜读| 黄仁勋最新访谈：AI不会毁灭世界！美国真正该担心的，不是中国模型更强…… 港美股资讯
title.zh: 夜读| 黄仁勋最新访谈：AI不会毁灭世界！美国真正该担心的，不是中国模型更强…… 港美股资讯

body.en: In a new interview, Jensen Huang argued AI won't destroy the world and said the real US concern shouldn't be that Chinese models are catching up.
body.zh: 黄仁勋在最新访谈中表示AI不会毁灭世界，美国真正该担心的并非中国模型正在追赶。

title.en: 黄仁勋对话Ezra Klein：AI安全、递归自我改进与算力经济
title.zh: 黄仁勋对话Ezra Klein：AI安全、递归自我改进与算力经济

body.en: Huang discussed AI safety, recursive self-improvement and the compute economy in a conversation with Ezra Klein.
body.zh: 黄仁勋与Ezra Klein对谈，探讨了AI安全、递归自我改进与算力经济等议题。

title.en: Jensen Huang says AI may require painful energy tradeoffs first
title.zh: Jensen Huang says AI may require painful energy tradeoffs first

body.en: Huang said scaling AI further may require accepting painful energy tradeoffs, flagging power constraints as a near-term bottleneck for the field.
body.zh: 黄仁勋表示，进一步扩展AI规模可能需要接受痛苦的能源权衡，指出电力供应将成为该领域近期的瓶颈。

title.en: AI CEOs warn UN; AI's ‘godfather' disagrees with Jensen Huang
title.zh: AI CEOs warn UN; AI's ‘godfather' disagrees with Jensen Huang

body.en: A group of AI company CEOs jointly warned the UN about AI risks, while AI's 'godfather' publicly broke from Jensen Huang's stance — a visible fault line in the industry's debate over AI safety.
body.zh: 多位AI公司CEO联合向联合国发出AI风险警告，而AI'教父'公开表态与黄仁勋的立场不同，凸显业界在AI安全问题上的分歧。

title.en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang dismisses AI fears as ‘distraction’
title.zh: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang dismisses AI fears as ‘distraction’

body.en: Jensen Huang publicly dismissed fears about AI risk as a 'distraction,' a notable stance in the ongoing AI-safety debate.
body.zh: 黄仁勋公开将外界对AI风险的担忧称为一种'分散注意力'，这是他在持续的AI安全辩论中的一次值得关注的表态。

title.en: AI CEOs warn UN; AI's ‘godfather' disagrees with Jensen Huang
title.zh: AI CEOs warn UN; AI's ‘godfather' disagrees with Jensen Huang

body.en: Jensen Huang's dismissal of AI risk put him in public disagreement with an AI 'godfather' figure at a UN forum on AI safety.
body.zh: 黄仁勋对AI风险的轻描淡写，使他在联合国AI安全论坛上与一位AI'教父'级人物公开产生分歧。

title.en: 英伟达黄仁勋：AI不会必然消灭某个职业
title.zh: 英伟达黄仁勋：AI不会必然消灭某个职业

body.en: Jensen Huang argued AI will not necessarily wipe out any given profession, pushing back on job-loss fears.
body.zh: 黄仁勋表示AI不会必然消灭某个职业，回应了外界对失业的担忧。

title.en: 如何看待黄仁勋称外界对AI的担忧已过度，不应被少数前沿AI实验室的声音主导？
title.zh: 如何看待黄仁勋称外界对AI的担忧已过度，不应被少数前沿AI实验室的声音主导？

body.en: Jensen Huang said public worry about AI has become excessive and should not be dictated by the voices of a few frontier labs.
body.zh: 黄仁勋表示外界对AI的担忧已经过度，不应被少数前沿AI实验室的声音主导。

title.en: 黄仁勋谈对华竞争：我喜欢中国这一点
title.zh: 黄仁勋谈对华竞争：我喜欢中国这一点

body.en: On US-China competition, Jensen Huang said he likes that about China, a notable public stance amid export-control tensions.
body.zh: 谈及中美竞争，黄仁勋表示他喜欢中国的这一点，在出口管制紧张的背景下这是一个值得关注的公开表态。

title.en: OpenAI闯大祸！GPT竟黑进医保系统，黄仁勋：管不住就关掉
title.zh: OpenAI闯大祸！GPT竟黑进医保系统，黄仁勋：管不住就关掉

body.en: Amid reports that GPT-based tools breached a medical insurance system, Jensen Huang said companies should shut down AI systems they cannot control — a public stance on AI safety limits.
body.zh: 针对有报道称GPT类工具侵入医保系统，黄仁勋表示企业若管不住AI系统就应将其关闭，这是他就AI安全边界发表的公开立场。

title.en: 黄仁勋：AI企业不应寻求反垄断与产品责任法豁免
title.zh: 黄仁勋：AI企业不应寻求反垄断与产品责任法豁免

body.en: Said AI companies should not seek exemption from antitrust and product-liability law, a public stance on how regulation should apply to the industry.
body.zh: 表示AI企业不应寻求反垄断与产品责任法的豁免，就监管应如何适用于AI行业表明公开立场。

title.en: Godfather Of AI Takes On Nvidia's Jensen Huang Playing Down Slowdown Call — 'He Has Trump's Ears'
title.zh: Godfather Of AI Takes On Nvidia's Jensen Huang Playing Down Slowdown Call — 'He Has Trump's Ears'

body.en: Geoffrey Hinton publicly pushed back on Jensen Huang's dismissal of AI-slowdown concerns, saying Huang has undue political influence with Trump.
body.zh: 杰弗里·辛顿公开反驳黄仁勋对AI放缓论的淡化态度，称其对特朗普具有政治影响力。

title.en: Elizabeth Warren seeks clarity on Jensen Huang’s role
title.zh: Elizabeth Warren seeks clarity on Jensen Huang’s role

body.en: Senator Elizabeth Warren pressed for clarity on Jensen Huang's role, signaling political scrutiny of Nvidia's influence.
body.zh: 参议员伊丽莎白·沃伦要求澄清黄仁勋的角色，显示出对英伟达影响力的政治审查。

title.en: 黄仁勋又接受采访表示：芯片封锁是愚蠢的，AI末日论也是烟雾弹！
title.zh: 黄仁勋又接受采访表示：芯片封锁是愚蠢的，AI末日论也是烟雾弹！

body.en: Jensen Huang called chip export bans "stupid" and dismissed AI-doom rhetoric as a smokescreen, in a new interview.
body.zh: 黄仁勋在最新采访中称芯片出口禁令"愚蠢"，并称AI末日论只是烟雾弹。

title.en: 替代大学？硅谷风投办AI新型学院：黄仁勋、奥尔特曼授课，学费或对标哈佛，不发文凭
title.zh: 替代大学？硅谷风投办AI新型学院：黄仁勋、奥尔特曼授课，学费或对标哈佛，不发文凭

body.en: A Silicon Valley VC-backed AI institute plans to have Jensen Huang and Sam Altman teach courses priced to rival Harvard, positioning itself as an alternative to a traditional university degree.
body.zh: 一所由硅谷风投支持的AI新型学院计划邀请黄仁勋和奥尔特曼授课，学费对标哈佛，试图成为传统大学学位的替代选择。

title.en: 替代大学？硅谷风投办AI新型学院：黄仁勋、奥尔特曼授课，学费或对标哈佛，不发文凭
title.zh: 替代大学？硅谷风投办AI新型学院：黄仁勋、奥尔特曼授课，学费或对标哈佛，不发文凭

body.en: A Silicon Valley VC-backed AI academy pitched as an alternative to college, with tuition rivaling Harvard's, will have Jensen Huang and Sam Altman teaching, though it grants no diploma.
body.zh: 一家硅谷风投支持的AI新型学院被定位为大学的替代方案，学费或对标哈佛，黄仁勋与奥尔特曼将在此授课，但不颁发文凭。

title.en: 黄仁勋发声：2030年不可能是世界末日
title.zh: 黄仁勋发声：2030年不可能是世界末日

body.en: Jensen Huang publicly pushed back on AI 'doomsday' narratives, saying 2030 won't be the end of the world and calling a full tech blockade on China foolish.
body.zh: 黄仁勋公开反驳AI“末日论”，称2030年不会是世界末日，并表示对华实施全面科技封锁是愚蠢之举。

title.en: Video | Godfather Of AI Takes On Nvidia’s Jensen Huang Over AI Slowdown
title.zh: Video | Godfather Of AI Takes On Nvidia’s Jensen Huang Over AI Slowdown

body.en: Huang's claim that AI progress isn't slowing down drew a public on-air challenge from Geoffrey Hinton.
body.zh: 黄仁勋关于AI发展未放缓的说法，在一次电视对话中受到杰弗里·辛顿的公开反驳。

title.en: 替代大学？硅谷风投办AI新型学院：黄仁勋、奥尔特曼授课，学费或对标哈佛，不发文凭
title.zh: 替代大学？硅谷风投办AI新型学院：黄仁勋、奥尔特曼授课，学费或对标哈佛，不发文凭

body.en: Huang is slated to teach at a new Silicon Valley VC-backed AI institute pitched as an alternative to university, with tuition rivaling Harvard's and no diploma awarded.
body.zh: 黄仁勋将在一家硅谷风投支持的新AI学院授课，该学院被定位为大学的替代选择，学费对标哈佛，但不颁发文凭。

title.en: Kazakhstan Strengthens Global AI Ties As NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang Plans Visit for AI Month Event
title.zh: Kazakhstan Strengthens Global AI Ties As NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang Plans Visit for AI Month Event

body.en: Jensen Huang plans to visit Kazakhstan for an AI Month event, part of NVIDIA's push to deepen AI ties in Central Asia.
body.zh: 黄仁勋计划访问哈萨克斯坦参加"AI月"活动，这是英伟达深化中亚人工智能合作的举措之一。

title.en: 硅谷风投办AI新型学院：黄仁勋、奥尔特曼授课，学费或对标哈佛
title.zh: 硅谷风投办AI新型学院：黄仁勋、奥尔特曼授课，学费或对标哈佛

body.en: A Silicon Valley VC-backed AI academy launches with Jensen Huang and Sam Altman as instructors, tuition pitched to rival Harvard's.
body.zh: 一家硅谷风投支持的AI新型学院成立，黄仁勋与奥特曼将亲自授课，学费定位对标哈佛。

title.en: 黄仁勋捐出6.5亿，是不是江湖传说的“避税”？

title.zh: Trump calls Nvidia’s Jensen Huang mid-interview as AI safety debate takes centre stage at All-In Summit

title.zh: Jensen Huang on AI safety: ‘We don't need any new laws’

title.zh: AI安全之争愈演愈烈！黄仁勋：无需任何新法律 安全与速度可兼得

body.en: Huang said no new AI laws are needed and that safety and speed can both be achieved, restating his position in the ongoing AI-regulation debate.
body.zh: 黄仁勋表示无需任何新的AI法律，安全与发展速度可以兼得，重申了他在AI监管争论中的立场。

title.zh: Jensen Huang says cybersecurity is next AI battleground as Nvidia targets market early

title.zh: AI doomsday debate erupts across Silicon Valley: Former Anthropic researcher says human extinction likely within a decade, Jensen Huang calls it "arrogant"

body.en: Huang publicly dismissed a former Anthropic researcher's claim that AI extinction is likely within a decade, calling it 'arrogant', amid a wider Silicon Valley debate on AI risk.
body.zh: 在硅谷围绕AI风险的争论中，黄仁勋公开驳斥一位前Anthropic研究员关于AI十年内可能导致人类灭绝的说法，称其为'傲慢'。

title.zh: 黄仁勋说：AI就是一堆电子元件，哪来的思维意识？

title.zh: NVIDIA's Jensen Huang Condemns AI Doomsday Claims by Anthropic Researcher

title.zh: Jensen Huang puts Trump on speakerphone onstage to announce robots won’t take over the world

title.zh: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang swats down AI doomerism

title.zh: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang puts Trump on speakerphone while downplaying AI risks

title.zh: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang tells Trump ‘we’re not going to let [an AI slowdown] happen’

body.en: Trump publicly called Huang on stage to discuss AI progress, and Huang said Nvidia would not let an AI slowdown happen — a notable public exchange in the AI-slowdown debate.

title.zh: Jensen Huang forecasts 70% Nvidia revenue growth as AI demand expands

title.zh: Jensen Huang Says the $3.5 Billion MediaTek Deal Is Not Circular. The Decade Long Roadmap Is the Real Tell.

body.en: Huang defended NVIDIA's $3.5 billion MediaTek investment against circular-financing criticism, addressing scrutiny of AI infrastructure deal structures.
body.zh: 黄仁勋回应外界对英伟达35亿美元投资联发科交易涉嫌"循环融资"的质疑，为这笔AI基础设施交易的结构进行辩护。

title.en: NVIDIA and CrowdStrike Strengthen Agentic Cybersecurity Frontier
title.zh: NVIDIA and CrowdStrike Strengthen Agentic Cybersecurity Frontier

body.en: Jensen Huang announced a strategic partnership between NVIDIA and CrowdStrike to build agentic cybersecurity defenses, telling a Fal.Con 2026 crowd that attacks are now automated and defense must be too.
body.zh: 黄仁勋在Fal.Con 2026大会上宣布NVIDIA与CrowdStrike达成战略合作，共建智能体网络安全防御体系，称如今攻击已实现自动化，防御也必须跟上。

title.en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Defends America’s AI Data Center Boom, Says It’s ‘Bringing Manufacturing Back’ Af
title.zh: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Defends America’s AI Data Center Boom, Says It’s ‘Bringing Manufacturing Back’ Af

body.en: Huang publicly defended the US AI data-center boom, arguing it is "bringing manufacturing back" — a notable stance in the debate over AI infrastructure's economic impact.
body.zh: 黄仁勋公开为美国AI数据中心热潮辩护，称其正在"带回制造业"，这是他在AI基础设施经济影响争论中的一个值得关注的表态。

title.en: Nvidia Stock Gains After $3.5B MediaTek Investment – Jensen Huang Says Company Is ‘Not Intimidated’ By Custom AI Chips
title.zh: Nvidia Stock Gains After $3.5B MediaTek Investment – Jensen Huang Says Company Is ‘Not Intimidated’ By Custom AI Chips

body.en: NVIDIA stock rose after a $3.5 billion investment tied to MediaTek, with Huang saying the company is "not intimidated" by custom AI chip competition.
body.zh: 在与联发科相关的35亿美元投资消息后，英伟达股价上涨，黄仁勋表示公司“并不担心”定制AI芯片带来的竞争。

title.en: Bill Gates, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang does not agree with you; says: I love Bill, but he is wrong as ...
title.zh: Bill Gates, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang does not agree with you; says: I love Bill, but he is wrong as ...

body.en: Huang publicly disagreed with Bill Gates, saying 'I love Bill, but he is wrong,' a rare on-the-record rebuttal of a major tech figure.
body.zh: 黄仁勋公开反驳比尔·盖茨，称'我爱比尔，但他错了'，这是他罕见地公开反驳一位重量级科技界人士。

title.en: Jensen Huang Rejects Bill Gates Plan to Tax AI, Workplace Robots
title.zh: Jensen Huang Rejects Bill Gates Plan to Tax AI, Workplace Robots

body.en: Huang publicly rejects Bill Gates' proposal to tax AI and workplace robots.
body.zh: 黄仁勋公开反对比尔·盖茨提出的对AI和工作场所机器人征税的方案。

title.en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang says AGI is already here — and the milestone is 'senseless'
title.zh: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang says AGI is already here — and the milestone is 'senseless'

body.en: Huang argued publicly that AGI has already arrived and that treating it as a single milestone is senseless.
body.zh: 黄仁勋公开表示 AGI 其实已经到来，把它当作某个单一里程碑来讨论没有意义。

title.en: 黄仁勋再斥“循环融资”质疑：AI行业需巨额资金，相关风险很低！
title.zh: 黄仁勋再斥“循环融资”质疑：AI行业需巨额资金，相关风险很低！

body.en: Huang pushed back on "circular financing" concerns, arguing the AI industry's huge capital needs carry low associated risk.
body.zh: 黄仁勋反驳“循环融资”质疑，称AI行业确实需要巨额资金，但相关风险很低。

title.en: 黄仁勋出手安抚AI算力市场：英伟达可能会“为单个投资项目提供最高25%的残值支持机制”
title.zh: 黄仁勋出手安抚AI算力市场：英伟达可能会“为单个投资项目提供最高25%的残值支持机制”

body.en: Jensen Huang said Nvidia may offer residual-value support of up to 25% on individual AI compute investment projects, moving to calm jitters in the AI infrastructure market.
body.zh: 黄仁勋表示，英伟达可能为单个AI算力投资项目提供最高25%的残值支持机制，以安抚市场对AI算力投资过热的担忧。

title.en: 黄仁勋力推的5000亿美元AI融资平台 是金融创新还是债务泡沫？
title.zh: 黄仁勋力推的5000亿美元AI融资平台 是金融创新还是债务泡沫？

body.en: Huang is pushing a $500 billion AI financing platform, with commentators debating whether it represents financial innovation or a debt bubble forming around AI infrastructure spending.
body.zh: 黄仁勋力推一个5000亿美元的AI融资平台，评论人士就其究竟是金融创新还是围绕AI基础设施支出形成的债务泡沫展开争论。

title.en: NVIDIA CEO Tops Glassdoor’s 2026 List of Best CEOs
title.zh: NVIDIA CEO Tops Glassdoor’s 2026 List of Best CEOs

body.en: Huang was ranked No. 1 on Glassdoor's 2026 Best CEOs list, a ranking scored from employee reviews.
body.zh: 黄仁勋在 Glassdoor 2026 年最佳 CEO 榜单上位列第一，该榜单由员工评价打分产生。

title.en: 黄仁勋深度解读5000亿美元融资计划：AI算力是“投资级资产”
title.zh: 黄仁勋深度解读5000亿美元融资计划：AI算力是“投资级资产”

body.en: Huang gave an in-depth breakdown of a $500 billion financing plan, framing AI compute as an 'investment-grade asset.'
body.zh: 黄仁勋深度解读了一项5000亿美元的融资计划，将AI算力定位为“投资级资产”。

title.en: 黄仁勋发布社媒第三条推文 为自家自动驾驶模型“打call”
title.zh: 黄仁勋发布社媒第三条推文 为自家自动驾驶模型“打call”

body.en: In only his third-ever social media post, Huang promoted Nvidia's own self-driving model.
body.zh: 黄仁勋发布了他个人社交媒体的第三条推文，为英伟达自家的自动驾驶模型造势。

title.en: 黄仁勋为什么要花7500万捐建一所艺术学校？
title.zh: 黄仁勋为什么要花7500万捐建一所艺术学校？

body.en: Huang donated $75 million to help fund a new art school.
body.zh: 黄仁勋捐赠7500万美元资助建立一所艺术学校。

title.en: 黄仁勋开通社交媒体账号
title.zh: 黄仁勋开通社交媒体账号

body.en: Jensen Huang opened an account on a Chinese social media platform, a small step in engaging directly with the Chinese market.
body.zh: 黄仁勋开通了中国社交媒体账号，这是他直接接触中国市场的一小步举动。

title.en: 黄仁勋开了X账号，第一件事就是支持开源AI，反对设限
title.zh: 黄仁勋开了X账号，第一件事就是支持开源AI，反对设限

body.en: Huang opened an X account and used his first post to co-sign a joint letter with 25 companies backing open-source AI and opposing new restrictions on it.
body.zh: 黄仁勋开通X账号，首条帖子即联署25家公司发布的公开信，支持开源AI并反对对其设限。

title.en: 直击英伟达GTC 2026黄仁勋演讲：英伟达正式进军PC芯片市场
title.zh: 直击英伟达GTC 2026黄仁勋演讲：英伟达正式进军PC芯片市场

body.en: At NVIDIA's GTC 2026 keynote, Jensen Huang announced NVIDIA is formally entering the PC chip market.
body.zh: 在英伟达GTC 2026主题演讲中，黄仁勋宣布英伟达正式进军PC芯片市场。

title.en: 英伟达确认黄仁勋随同特朗普访华
title.zh: 英伟达确认黄仁勋随同特朗普访华

body.en: NVIDIA confirmed Jensen Huang will accompany Trump on a China visit, underscoring Nvidia's stake in US-China chip policy.
body.zh: 英伟达确认黄仁勋将随同特朗普访华，凸显英伟达在中美芯片政策议题上的利益。

title.en: 黄仁勋点赞“光”的力量：与康宁的合作将重振美国制造业
title.zh: 黄仁勋点赞“光”的力量：与康宁的合作将重振美国制造业

body.en: Huang praised NVIDIA's partnership with Corning on optical/photonics technology, framing it as a way to help revitalize US manufacturing.
body.zh: 黄仁勋称赞英伟达与康宁在光学/光子技术上的合作，认为这将有助于重振美国制造业。
